items.title: gRPC-Go: Heap Memory Exhaustion (OOM) via HTTP/2 DATA Frame Fragmentation
items.summary:
### Impact
An unauthenticated remote attacker can initiate a gRPC stream and purposefully fragment their payload into millions of tiny (e.g., 1-byte) HTTP/2 DATA frames. Even if the total payload volume falls within the configured connection and stream flow-control windows, each independent fragment incurs memory overhead due to internal tracking structures and queue allocation.

Repeated fragmentation massively inflates the heap space consumed by the stream. An attacker multiplexing multiple concurrent streams can exhaust the memory bounds of the runtime, forcing a runtime panic or OutOfMemory condition and leading to a remote Denial of Service (DoS).

### Patches
The change to fix this issue is merged in `master` and a patch release, 1.83.1, has been published that contains this fix.

### Workarounds
This vulnerability is mitigated by implementing receive buffer compaction. Consecutive small data buffers are automatically coalesced into larger buffers from a shared pool once the overhead is perceived to be excessive relative to actual payload data, drastically minimizing per-frame memory overheads.

This behavior is enabled by default. A temporary escape hatch is provided via the environment variable `GRPC_GO_EXPERIMENTAL_ENABLE_RECEIVE_BUFFER_COMPACTION=false` to disable the feature if unforeseen issues arise, but it will be removed in a future release.

items.title:
A flaw was found in Ansible Automation Platform's automation-controller (AWX).
The Bulk Job...
items.summary:
A flaw was found in Ansible Automation Platform's automation-controller (AWX).
The Bulk Job Launch API (POST /api/v2/bulk/job_launch/) authorizes the
requested instance_groups with only a read-level permission check, whereas the
standard single-job launch path requires use-level permission on the same
field. A principal that holds read (but not use) permission on an instance
group -- for example the built-in read-only System Auditor role -- together
with execute permission on a job template can launch bulk jobs onto instance
groups they are not authorized to use, bypassing execution-placement
isolation.

items.summary:
### Problem
The referrer enforcement introduced with [TYPO3-CORE-SA-2020-006](https://news.typo3.com/security/advisory/typo3-core-sa-2020-006) ([CVE-2020-11069](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-11069)) became ineffective in TYPO3 v13.0, where TYPO3 CMS started serving the backend and Admin Tool applications from the site's main entry script instead of the dedicated typo3/ directory.

Whether a request originated from the backend or Install Tool itself was determined by comparing the referrer against the directory of the entry script, which since then is the site root. As a consequence, requests originating from any script running on one of the TYPO3 instance's own domains, such as a frontend page, were accepted by backend routes and Install Tool endpoints.

Attackers able to execute JavaScript on one of those domains, for instance by exploiting a cross-site scripting vulnerability, could invoke these endpoints via Fetch/XHR with the privileges of an authenticated victim's user session.

### Solution
Update to TYPO3 versions 13.4.34 LTS, 14.3.6 LTS that fix the problem described.

### Credits
Thanks to Hổ Cao Từ for reporting this issue, and to TYPO3 core & security team member Benjamin Franzke for fixing it.

items.title: Filament: Multi-factor authentication (app) codes can still be used after a newer code has been used
items.summary:
A flaw in the handling of one-time codes for app-based multi-factor authentication allows a previously issued code to be used after a newer code has already been accepted. This issue does not affect email-based MFA. Submitting the exact same code twice was already prevented, but any other code within the accepted time window was not.

If an attacker gains access to both the user's password and a single one-time code, that code stays usable for the remainder of its time window, which is around four minutes on the default settings, including after the legitimate user has already logged in with a newer code.

items.title: sqlparse: Reindentation of tuple lists causes near-cap quadratic CPU consumption
items.summary:
### Summary

When SQL is formatted with reindentation enabled, `ReindentFilter` repeatedly rebuilds prefixes of the current statement to calculate token offsets. An attacker who controls SQL sent to this opt-in formatting path can supply a parenthesized tuple list that remains just below the grouping-token cap. Thousands of offset calculations then traverse an expanding token tree, causing multi-second CPU consumption from an input of roughly 16 KB and degrading service availability.

### Details

`ReindentFilter._get_offset()` joins the tokens returned by `_flatten_up_to_token()` to calculate the current output position. Each call begins by flattening the current statement from its start and walks until the target token. Tuple-list reindentation invokes this calculation repeatedly as it processes many parenthesized values, so later calls redo an increasingly large amount of prior work.

The vulnerable path is reached through `sqlparse.format(sql, reindent=True)` and `sqlformat --reindent`. A carefully sized tuple list completes grouping below the configured token cap and then enters the expensive reindentation path; a slightly larger input may instead be rejected quickly by the cap.

Relevant code locations:

- `sqlparse/formatter.py:170` — enabling `ReindentFilter`
- `sqlparse/filters/reindent.py:30` — repeated flattening from the statement start
- `sqlparse/filters/reindent.py:44` — prefix joining for offset calculation
- `sqlparse/filters/reindent.py:216` — tuple-list processing path

### PoC

A complete validated reproduction is attached as [reindent_tuple_list_cpu_dos-poc.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29410152/reindent_tuple_list_cpu_dos-poc.zip). The archive contains `reproduction/` at its root, uses Git and Docker, and compares two same-shape tuple-list inputs formatted with reindentation enabled.

Extract the archive beside this report, then run:

```console
./reproduction/run.sh
```

Observed result:

The 600-tuple baseline completed in 0.649 seconds, while the below-cap 1,425-tuple input completed in 4.999 seconds. The run emitted `EVOHUNT_REINDENT_DOS_VERIFIED` and completed successfully.

Verification method:

The verification helper formats two same-shape tuple-list payloads with `reindent=True` and fails unless the larger payload completes successfully, takes at least 2.0 seconds, and takes at least 4x the baseline.

Limitations:

No reproduction blocker was recorded. Timing varies by host, and exploitation requires the reindentation option or corresponding CLI mode to be enabled.

### Impact

This is a CPU resource-exhaustion vulnerability in workflows that reindent attacker-controlled SQL. A small crafted tuple-list input can occupy a worker for several seconds, enabling request delays, reduced throughput, or worker starvation when payloads are processed repeatedly or concurrently.

The affected reindentation behavior is opt-in, and sqlparse itself does not provide network exposure; reachability depends on the consuming application or CLI workflow. The demonstrated effect is CPU consumption in a single formatting call, not process termination, code execution, or confidentiality or integrity impact.

items.title: ApostropheCMS: Stored XSS via SVG SMIL URI-list scheme-policy bypass
items.summary: ### Summary When SVG animation is allowed, `attributeName="href"` makes `values` a list of URL destinations. `sanitize-html` accepts a list that starts with a safe fragment even when `values` is explicitly scheme-checked, allowing a later `javascript:` destination to execute when the sanitized link is activated. ### Details `index.js:371-383` validates each attribute as one flat URL. It does not recognize that `attributeName="href"` gives the sibling `values` attribute SMIL URI-list semantics. For `values="#safe;javascript:..."`, the leading fragment passes the flat check and the complete list is retained. ### PoC This was reproduced with `sanitize-html@2.17.6` and Chromium 150.0.7871.124. The configuration adds SVG animation to the defaults and applies the existing scheme policy to `values`; it does not allow `javascript:`. Save this as `poc.js`: ```js const sanitize = require('sanitize-html'); const input = ``; const output = sanitize(input, { allowedTags: sanitize.defaults.allowedTags.concat(['svg', 'animate', 'text']), allowedAttributes: { ...sanitize.defaults.allowedAttributes, animate: ['attributename', 'values', 'dur', 'fill'], text: ['y'] }, allowedSchemesAppliedToAttributes: sanitize.defaults.allowedSchemesAppliedToAttributes.concat(['values']) }); console.log(output); ``` Install and run it, then open `poc.html` and click `Click me`: ```sh npm install sanitize-html@2.17.6 node poc.js > poc.html ``` The output retains the `javascript:` entry, and clicking the sanitized SVG displays `XSS`. With `input` changed to `control`, the same configuration removes `href`. ### Impact In an application that accepts attacker-authored SVG animation, the attacker can store this payload without scripts or event handlers. A victim who activates the sanitized link executes JavaScript in the application's origin despite the configured scheme policy. ### Suggested fix Reject `attributeName` values selecting `href` or `xlink:href` on SVG `animate` and `set`, while retaining safe targets such as `fill`. Add `values`, `from`, and `to` regression cases.

items.title: NLTK: Uncontrolled search path when invoking the Graphviz 'dot' binary
items.summary:
Two NLTK sites executed the Graphviz `dot` program by bare name, so process creation resolved it via the search path — and on Windows via the current working directory — rather than a validated absolute location. An attacker who can place a file named `dot` where resolution looks (the CWD on Windows, or a writable/relative entry such as `.` on `PATH`) has their binary executed in place of Graphviz (arbitrary code execution).

Affected (<= 3.10.2):
- `nltk.parse.dependencygraph.dot2img` — called `find_binary("dot")` but discarded the returned validated path and then ran the bare name `["dot", ...]`, so the validation had no effect.
- `nltk.translate.api.AlignedSent._repr_svg_` — ran the bare name with no validation at all (IPython SVG rendering).

This is the same class already fixed for the senna, weka, boxer, malt, repp and hunpos wrappers. `nltk.internals.find_binary` refuses a CWD-relative match for a bare tool name and returns only a trusted absolute path; the fix runs that path in both sites.

---

## Attack demonstration
Captured output, not illustrative. A `./dot` that writes a `PWNED` marker, planted in the CWD with `.` prepended to `PATH`.

**The vulnerable behaviour (old bare-name exec):**
```
Control (OLD behavior) — bare ['dot'] in this dir with '.' on PATH:
  bare ['dot'] executed planted binary = True
```

**The patched functions refuse it:**
```
FIXED code, with ./dot planted and '.' on PATH:
  dependencygraph.dot2img : Exception "Cannot find the dot binary..."  | planted-binary-executed=False  safe
  AlignedSent._repr_svg_  : Exception "Cannot find the dot binary..."  | planted-binary-executed=False  safe
```

**And `find_binary` itself was attacked directly** (the fix trusts nothing else):
```
Attack 1: ./dot in CWD, no dot on PATH            -> LookupError (refused)  safe
Attack 2: ./dot/dot (dir 'dot' holding 'dot')     -> LookupError (refused)  safe
Attack 3: '.' on PATH + ./dot                     -> LookupError (refused)  safe
Attack 4: attacker-writable ABSOLUTE dir on PATH  -> returned /…/evilbin/dot (absolute)
```
Attack 4 is out of scope: trusting an absolute directory that is already on `PATH` is the operating system's own trust model — an attacker who can write to a `PATH` directory owns the account regardless of NLTK. `find_binary` defends specifically against the CWD/relative injection that bare-name exec is vulnerable to (attacks 1–3), which is exactly what this fix inherits.

Environment: python 3.13.7. `dot` is not required to reproduce — the planted binary is the payload.

items.title: Django REST framework: Potential bypass of Django `DATA_UPLOAD_MAX_MEMORY_SIZE` when parsing oversized JSON and urlencoded request bodies via DRF `request.data`
items.summary:
## Summary

While investigating Django REST Framework's request parsing behavior, I identified that DRF's high-level `request.data` parsing appears to bypass Django's configured `DATA_UPLOAD_MAX_MEMORY_SIZE` protection for `application/json` and `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` request bodies.

In the tested configurations, Django correctly raises `RequestDataTooBig` when applications access `request.body` or Django's native `request.POST`, but DRF successfully parses the same oversized payloads through `request.data`.

This behavior appears to occur because DRF passes the underlying `HttpRequest` object directly to parsers, which consume the request stream through Django's lower-level streaming interface rather than the guarded `request.body` path.

I am reporting this privately because I am unsure whether this behavior is considered part of DRF's intended security boundary, but it appears to bypass a documented Django request-size protection for common DRF request parsing paths and may have availability implications.


# What I Verified

I verified the behavior locally using the following combinations:

* Django **6.0.7** + DRF **3.17.1** → **Affected**
* Django **6.0.7** + DRF **current upstream main** → **Affected**

For both versions, the observed behavior was:

```
Django request.body
→ RequestDataTooBig

Django request.POST (application/x-www-form-urlencoded)
→ RequestDataTooBig

Django request.read()
→ Reads the entire oversized request body

DRF request.data
→ Successfully parses oversized JSON and urlencoded request bodies
```

I also confirmed that:

* `multipart/form-data` remains protected because DRF delegates multipart parsing to Django's multipart parser.
* The behavior reproduces on both direct WSGI and ASGI servers without a reverse proxy or external request-size middleware.


# Technical Details

The relevant execution flow is:

```
APIView

↓

rest_framework.request.Request

↓

request.data

↓

Request._load_data_and_files()

↓

Request._parse()

↓

Request._load_stream()

↓

self._stream = self._request

↓

JSONParser.parse(...)
or
FormParser.parse(...)

↓

stream.read() / json.load(...)
```

The important implementation detail is that DRF assigns the original Django `HttpRequest` object as the parser stream.

Unlike `request.body` and Django's native form parsing, consuming the stream through `HttpRequest.read()` does not trigger Django's `RequestDataTooBig` protection.

As a result, DRF's built-in parsers successfully consume oversized request bodies that Django itself would reject through its higher-level request interfaces.


# Reproduction Steps

## Environment

Python 3.13

Django 6.0.7

Django REST Framework 3.17.1 (also reproduced on current upstream main)

Configure:

```python
DATA_UPLOAD_MAX_MEMORY_SIZE = 10
```

Create a simple DRF API view:

```python
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response

class DemoView(APIView):
    def post(self, request):
        return Response(request.data)
```

Start the application.

Send an oversized JSON request:

```
POST /demo
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: >10 bytes
```

Example:

```json
{
  "value": "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA..."
}
```

Observed:

```
HTTP 200

JSON successfully parsed
```

Now compare against:

```python
request.body
```

Observed:

```
RequestDataTooBig
```

Likewise, compare against:

```python
request.POST
```

using

```
application/x-www-form-urlencoded
```

Observed:

```
RequestDataTooBig
```

This demonstrates different enforcement depending on which request API is used.


# Root Cause

Django documents `HttpRequest.read()` as a streaming interface.

DRF exposes `request.data` as the primary high-level request parsing API.

Currently, DRF forwards the raw Django request stream directly to parsers before any request-size validation equivalent to Django's `request.body` path occurs.

Consequently:

* JSONParser
* FormParser

fully consume oversized request bod

items.title: Django REST framework: AdminRenderer may disclose GET-protected data when rendering invalid write requests
items.summary:
Summary

AdminRenderer may disclose data that would normally be protected by GET permissions when rendering a 400 Bad Request response for an invalid write request.

If a view allows POST (or another write method) but denies GET, an invalid request rendered through AdminRenderer can invoke the view's GET handler and include data from the GET representation in the generated HTML response.

This behavior appears to be specific to AdminRenderer and does not affect the normal JSON rendering path.


---

Details

While investigating the AdminRenderer rendering flow, I observed that invalid write requests are rendered by temporarily overriding the request method and invoking the view's GET handler:

```
with override_method(view, request, "GET") as request:
    response = view.get(request, *view.args, **view.kwargs)

data = response.data
```

This execution path differs from a normal GET request.

Under normal request processing, a GET request flows through:

```
APIView.dispatch()
    └── APIView.initial()
            └── APIView.check_permissions()
```

However, during AdminRenderer rendering, the renderer directly invokes:

view.get(...)

A view whose permission class explicitly allowed POST but denied GET still executed its GET handler while rendering an invalid POST request through AdminRenderer.

As a result, data intended to be available only through an authorized GET request was included in the generated HTML response.


---

Proof of Concept

Using a standard ListCreateAPIView.

Permission class:

```
class ProbePermission(BasePermission):
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        return request.method == "POST"

View:

class View(ListCreateAPIView):
    renderer_classes = (AdminRenderer, JSONRenderer)
    permission_classes = (ProbePermission,)
    serializer_class = ProbeSerializer

    def get_queryset(self):
        return [
            {
                "name": "visible",
                "secret": "GET-ONLY-SECRET",
            }
        ]
```

Expected Behaviour

```
GET request
→ 403 Forbidden

Invalid POST request
→ 400 Bad Request
→ Response should contain only validation errors.
→ GET-only data should not be rendered.

```
Observed Behaviour

```
GET request
→ 403 Forbidden

Invalid POST request rendered through AdminRenderer
→ 400 Bad Request
→ HTML response contains:

GET-ONLY-SECRET
```

Tthe same behavior is shown using a minimal APIView implementation.

Observed results:

```
minimal.post_400.handler_calls =
[
    ("post", "POST"),
    ("get", "GET")
]

minimal.post_400.contains_secret = True
```

Generic view reproduction:

```
generic.direct_get.status = 403
generic.direct_get.contains_secret = False

generic.post_400.status = 400
generic.post_400.contains_secret = True

generic.post_400.permission_calls =
[
    ("GenericAdminView", "POST"),
    ...
    ("GenericAdminView", "OPTIONS")
]

generic.post_400.queryset_calls =
[
    ("GenericAdminView", "GET"),
    ...
]
```

These observations indicate that direct GET requests are correctly denied, while the simulated GET used during AdminRenderer rendering can still retrieve the protected representation.


---

Impact

This issue may result in information disclosure when all of the following conditions are met:

AdminRenderer is enabled.

The client negotiates the HTML renderer (for example using Accept: text/html).

items.title: nanoid: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
items.summary:
### Summary

An integer overflow in `nanoid(size)` permanently corrupts the process-wide CSPRNG pool, causing all subsequent ID generation to return the deterministic string `"uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu"`. Any application that passes user-influenced values to the `size` parameter loses all randomness guarantees for session tokens, CSRF tokens, and unique identifiers until process restart.

### Details

`nanoid()` at [`index.js:101`](https://github.com/ai/nanoid/blob/main/index.js#L101) coerces the `size` parameter with `size |= 0`, which converts it to a signed 32-bit integer. When `size >= 2^31` (e.g., `2147483648`), this wraps to `-2147483648`.

The negative value is passed to `fillPool()` ([`index.js:15`](https://github.com/ai/nanoid/blob/main/index.js#L15)):

```javascript
function fillPool(bytes) {
  if (!pool || pool.length < bytes) {       // false: pool exists, -2B < pool.length
    pool = Buffer.allocUnsafe(bytes * POOL_SIZE_MULTIPLIER)
    crypto.getRandomValues(pool)
    poolOffset = 0
  } else if (poolOffset + bytes > pool.length) {  // false: poolOffset + (-2B) < pool.length
    crypto.getRandomValues(pool)
    poolOffset = 0
  }
  poolOffset += bytes  // poolOffset += -2147483648 → deeply negative
}
```

Neither branch triggers, so the pool is never refreshed. `poolOffset` becomes ~-2.1 billion.

Subsequent `nanoid()` calls execute:
```javascript
for (let i = poolOffset - size; i < poolOffset; i++) {
  id += scopedUrlAlphabet[pool[i] & 63]
}
```

`pool[negative_index]` returns `undefined`. `undefined & 63` evaluates to `0`. `urlAlphabet[0]` is `'u'`. Every ID becomes `"uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu"`.

The corruption is **persistent** — it affects all subsequent calls in the process until ~100 million calls eventually wrap `poolOffset` back to positive, or the process restarts.

### PoC

```javascript
import { nanoid } from 'nanoid'

// Step 1: Normal operation
console.log(nanoid())  // e.g., "V1StGXR8_Z5jdHi6B-myT"

// Step 2: Trigger overflow (e.g., from an API parameter)
try { nanoid(2147483648) } catch(e) {}

// Step 3: All subsequent IDs are deterministic
console.log(nanoid())  // "uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu"
console.log(nanoid())  // "uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu"
console.log(nanoid())  // "uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu"
// ... forever, process-wide
```

Run with: `node --experimental-vm-modules poc.mjs`

Attack scenario: Any API endpoint that accepts a user-controlled length/size parameter (URL shortener slug length, configurable token size, etc.) and passes it to `nanoid(userInput)`.

### Impact

**Complete loss of ID unpredictability and uniqueness, process-wide, from a single request.**

- All session IDs, CSRF tokens, API keys, and database identifiers generated after the attack are identical and predictable
- An attacker can predict all tokens issued to other users, enabling session hijacking and authentication bypass
- The corruption is persistent (survives across requests) and affects all consumers of `nanoid` in the same process
- No special privileges or preconditions required — a single unauthenticated request is sufficient
- Affects any application that passes external input to the `size` parameter without validation

items.title: Appium: Reflected XSS / arbitrary JS in @appium/base-driver /test/guinea-pig* routes
items.summary: ## Summary Appium's base-driver mounts the built-in `/test/guinea-pig`, `/test/guinea-pig-scrollable` and `/test/guinea-pig-app-banner` routes **unconditionally** on every server. The handler reflects the `throwError` query param, the `comments` POST field, and the `User-Agent` request header into the returned HTML via `compileLodashTemplate`, which interpolates `<%= expr %>` as `String(expr)` with **no HTML/JS escaping**. This yields reflected XSS, and the `throwError` value is reflected **inside a `) ``` ### Impact An attacker who can get a victim to open a crafted link (or auto-submit a form) to the Appium server executes arbitrary JavaScript on the server's origin. With default CORS `*` + no authentication, that JS can drive the WebDriver REST API and plugin endpoints. The endpoints are debug/test fixtures that should not be reachable on a production listener at all.

items.title: Smarty: SSRF via redirect bypass of trusted_uri using {fetch}
items.summary:
When a Security policy is active, {fetch} validates the requested remote URL against the trusted_uri allowlist via Security::isTrustedUri(). For non-http:// schemes (e.g. https://) the resource was then read with file_get_contents(), which follows HTTP redirects by default. Because isTrustedUri() only validates the initial URL, an open redirect on an otherwise-trusted host could be used to redirect the request to a non-trusted, internal target — bypassing the trusted_uri policy.

## Impact

An attacker who can supply a fetch target (or influence one) and who has an open redirect available on a trusted host can cause the server to issue requests to attacker-chosen internal endpoints, defeating the trusted_uri allowlist (server-side request forgery).

## Patches

Fixed in 5.8.2. When a security policy is active, {fetch} now passes a stream context that disables redirect following (follow_location => 0, max_redirects => 1) to file_get_contents() for remote resources. Behavior is unchanged when no security policy is set, since there is no trusted_uri to bypass.

## Workarounds

Avoid fetching remote resources from within templates under untrusted control; ensure hosts listed in trusted_uri do not expose open redirects.

items.title: Kirby: System path exposure from error messages in the REST API
items.summary:
### TL;DR

This vulnerability affects all Kirby sites that have not disabled the REST API with the `'api' => false` option.

It was possible to trigger a PHP error in the API backend that would expose the full filesystem path of the Kirby installation on the server. This could be used to guess the default `content.salt` or prepare specialized attacks.

----

### Introduction

An information exposure occurs when system data or debugging information leaves the program through an output stream or logging function that makes it accessible to unauthorized parties. Using other weaknesses, an attacker could cause errors to occur; the response to these errors can reveal detailed system information, along with other impacts. An attacker can use messages that reveal technologies, operating systems, and product versions to tune the attack against known vulnerabilities in these technologies. A product may use diagnostic methods that provide significant implementation details such as stack traces as part of its error handling mechanism.

### Affected components

Kirby's REST API at `/api` returns JSON data for each request. If an error occurs during processing of the request, a special error handler converts this error to JSON data that API frontends can handle.

The returned data for errors depends on the debugging mode. If the `debug` option is enabled, the JSON data contains fields for the path and line of the affected file, the internal exception class and the API route that caused the error. This data is omitted from error responses in production (when the `debug` option is disabled).

### Impact

Some internal errors may contain sensitive information in the error message itself. This is often the case with PHP errors.

In affected releases, the REST API error handler did not sanitize error messages for sensitive information.

This exposed system information like the full source path to external API users, including users without authentication. This could be used to guess the default `content.salt` or prepare specialized attacks.

### Patches

The problem has been patched in [Kirby 4.9.5](https://github.com/getkirby/kirby/releases/tag/4.9.5) and [Kirby 5.5.2](https://github.com/getkirby/kirby/releases/tag/5.5.2). Please update to one of these or a [later version](https://github.com/getkirby/kirby/releases) to fix the vulnerability.

In all of the mentioned releases, Kirby has hardened the API error handler to only expose full error messages for exceptions in the `Kirby\Exception` namespace. All other errors are only exposed in debug mode (with disguised paths, keeping only the paths relative to the Kirby installation). Outside of debug mode, general exceptions and PHP errors are replaced with a generic error message.

### Credits

Thanks to Peter Levashov (@petersevera) for responsibly reporting the identified issue.

items.summary: WWBN AVideo (current e01e41ecc and earlier) makes three login-time security controls depend solely on the client-supplied User-Agent header. The isAVideoEncoder()/isAVideoMobileApp() checks match HTTP_USER_AGENT against a hardcoded literal ("AVideoEncoder"/"AVideoMobileApp") with no IP check or shared secret. An attacker who submits valid credentials and sets User-Agent: AVideoEncoder bypasses two-factor authentication, skips brute-force captcha escalation, and avoids being recorded in the login/device audit history. No patch is available at the time of publication.

items.title: Predis is a flexible and feature-complete Redis and Valkey client for PHP. From version 3.0.0-RC1 until version 3.3.0, pipeline handling on aggregate cluster and replication con...
items.summary: Predis is a flexible and feature-complete Redis and Valkey client for PHP. From version 3.0.0-RC1 until version 3.3.0, pipeline handling on aggregate cluster and replication connections reparses an already serialized RESP buffer in AbstractAggregateConnection::write() by splitting it with explode("\r\n") instead of honoring RESP length prefixes. Attacker-controlled keys or values containing CRLF sequences can therefore be interpreted by Command::deserializeCommand() as additional commands. On cluster connections, ClusterStrategy::getFakeKey() can route injected keyless commands using the literal fake key value "key", permitting operations such as shard-wide cache deletion, targeted data modification, data reads, or node disruption. On replication connections, malformed reparsing can throw an uncaught exception and repeatedly terminate affected requests. Only pipeline() reaches this vulnerable path; transaction() and MULTI are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 3.3.0.

items.title: Goploy is an open-source automation deployment system. In versions 1.17.5 and prior, Project.AddFile, Project.EditFile, Project.RemoveFile, and Project.Edit in cmd/server/api/pr...
items.summary: Goploy is an open-source automation deployment system. In versions 1.17.5 and prior, Project.AddFile, Project.EditFile, Project.RemoveFile, and Project.Edit in cmd/server/api/project/handler.go accept a project or project-file row id from the JSON body and act on it without checking that the project belongs to the caller's namespace. The corresponding model.ProjectFile.GetData and model.Project.GetData queries filter only by row id. A user holding the manager role (or any role that includes the FileSync / EditProject permission) in their own namespace can read, write, or delete files in any project across the install, and can rewrite any project's git remote URL by submitting the foreign id in the body. The git-URL primitive escalates to RCE on the next deploy because Edit runs git remote set-url on the project's working tree. At time of publication, there are no known publicly available patches.

items.title: Towards Operator-Empowered Vulnerability Hotfixing for 5G Radio Access Networks
items.summary: Cellular protocol vulnerabilities can remain exploitable for months or years while standards bodies, vendors, and mobile network operators (MNOs) coordinate permanent fixes. We present Buckler, a framework that enables an MNO to deploy temporary, local, and reversible hotfixes in its radio access network (RAN) during this exposure window. Buckler places reusable hooks at standardized L2/L3 channel boundaries and exposes a closed, stateful match-action interface with three preventive actions: DROP, MODIFY, and RELEASE. We evaluate whether this bounded design provides useful coverage without requiring extensive changes to existing RANs. From 23 papers, we identify 64 attacks rooted in standard L2/L3 protocol behavior, of which 43 provide a preventive intervention point at the RAN, and we construct Buckler hotfixes for 20 of them. All 20 hotfixes use the same rule vocabulary and only five standardized channel hooks, while the unsupported attacks expose endpoint dependencies that a RAN cannot satisfy alone. We implement the five hooks on srsRAN and OpenAirInterface with small, structurally similar changes, and demonstrate all three actions against representative availability and privacy attacks. These results establish operator-empowered hotfixing as a practical and portable interim defense and delineate the architectural limits of RAN-only prevention.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 蜂窝网络协议中的漏洞常因标准组织、设备商与移动网络运营商(MNO)之间的多方协调而长期得不到修复，暴露窗口可能持续数月至数年。本文提出Buckler框架，允许MNO在此窗口期内在无线接入网(RAN)侧部署临时的、本地的且可逆的热修复。Buckler在标准化的L2/L3信道边界放置可复用的钩子，并对外提供一种封闭的、有状态的匹配-动作接口，支持DROP(丢弃)、MODIFY(修改)和RELEASE(放行)三种预防动作。作者从23篇相关论文中梳理出64个根植于标准L2/L3协议行为的攻击，其中43个可在RAN侧找到预防性干预点；利用Buckler为其中的20个攻击构建了热修复。所有热修复仅需相同的规则词汇与五个标准化信道钩子；未被支持的攻击则涉及RAN无法单独满足的端点依赖。作者在srsRAN和OpenAirInterface上实现了这五个钩子，代码改动小且结构相似，并实际演示了三种动作对可用性及隐私攻击的缓解效果。这些工作证明了运营商赋能热修复是一种实用且可移植的临时防御方案，同时清晰揭示了仅靠RAN进行预防的架构性局限。本文适合5G安全研究者、MNO安全工程师以及协议栈开发者阅读，以理解在标准补丁落地前如何主动降低协议漏洞的利用风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 蜂窝协议漏洞的利用窗口往往很长，运营商缺乏快速缓解手段。Buckler提出的RAN侧钩子与match-action模型，为漏洞披露后、补丁发布前提供临时防护，具有显著现实价值，也启发了其他协议场景的应急缓解设计。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响5G RAN协议层临时防护的可行性与部署模式；该方法可扩展至其他无线及有线协议栈的应急修复，降低漏洞暴露期风险。
defense_advice_zh: 运营商应将RAN侧临时热修复纳入漏洞响应流程，作为等待正式补丁期间的缓解措施。
在部署热修复前，应在测试环境中充分验证钩子组合与动作规则，避免影响正常业务。
对DROP、MODIFY、RELEASE动作的执行进行日志记录与监控，以便及时感知针对热修复的探测或绕过尝试。

items.title: MROP: Mask-Region Optimized Purification Against Backdoor Attack in Deep JSCC
items.summary: Deep joint source and channel coding (JSCC) transmits a source by mapping it directly to channel symbols through an end-to-end deep neural network (DNN) and reconstructing it at the receiver. Taking image transmission as an application, this DNN pipeline behaves as a black box: the receiver cannot readily detect security attacks when the transmitted images are corrupted, thereby introducing a new security vulnerability. In this letter, we study defense against input-patch backdoor attacks on deep JSCC, in which a small trigger patch attached to the input forces the decoder to emit an attacker-chosen target image. Most existing patch-trigger defenses are designed for classification, leaving the reconstruction setting of deep JSCC unaddressed. We adapt the gradient mask defense to this reconstruction setting as a baseline and then propose mask-region optimized purification (MROP), which operates at inference and requires no retraining of the JSCC model. Unlike the baseline, which localizes the trigger from the input--output gradient, MROP instead places a per-pixel mask at the encoder input and optimizes it via a Gumbel-sigmoid relaxation to localize the trigger, then refines the trigger region to reconstruct the pure images better. In numerical results, we evaluate the proposed method on CIFAR-10 and STL-10 datasets along with the DeepJSCC and SwinJSCC models. By doing so, we show that the proposed method substantially lowers the attack success rate (ASR) while preserving the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of clean reconstructions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究面向深度联合信源信道编码（Deep JSCC）系统中输入补丁后门攻击的防御问题。Deep JSCC通过端到端深度神经网络将信源直接映射为信道符号并在接收端重构，以图像传输为例，该流程在黑盒条件下存在安全隐患：接收端难以察觉传输图像被篡改，从而引入新的安全漏洞。作者针对一种特定的输入补丁后门攻击——在输入图像上附加一个小型触发补丁，迫使解码器输出攻击者指定的目标图像——提出了基于掩码区域优化的净化方法（MROP）。现有的大多数补丁触发防御方法主要面向分类任务，并不适用于Deep JSCC的重构场景。作者先将梯度掩码防御适配到重构设置作为基线，然后提出MROP。MROP在推理阶段运行，无需对JSCC模型进行重训练。与基线从输入-输出梯度中定位触发区域不同，MROP在编码器输入端设置逐像素掩码，并通过Gumbel-sigmoid松弛技术优化该掩码以定位触发区域，随后对触发区域进行精细化处理，以更好地重构纯净图像。在CIFAR-10和STL-10数据集上，结合DeepJSCC和SwinJSCC模型进行实验，结果表明该方法在保持干净重构峰值信噪比（PSNR）的同时，显著降低了攻击成功率（ASR）。本文的核心贡献在于首次针对Deep JSCC重构场景提出有效的后门防御方法，通过可微的掩码优化在推理阶段消除触发补丁影响，无需修改模型结构或重新训练，为深度JSCC在实际部署中的安全性提供了重要保障。适合对无线通信安全、深度学习模型鲁棒性以及后门防御研究感兴趣的读者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 深度JSCC作为新兴的语义通信范式，其安全性研究尚属空白，本文提出的无重训练推理阶段防御可直接用于保护无线图像传输系统免遭后门攻击，对实际部署具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 针对Deep JSCC的后门攻击防御可迁移至其他生成式重构模型（如GAN、扩散模型）的输入净化场景，也可用于端到端通信系统的安全增强。

items.title: Drishti: AI-Led Human-Directed Vulnerability Auditing for 5G Cores
items.summary: Candidate generation for open-source vulnerabilities is no longer scarce. AI-assisted code review now produces defect candidates cheaply, and industry programs pair them with expert human triage. The remaining scarcity is validation and impact assessment, and the gap is largest in critical-infrastructure software like 5G cores. Here, validation has four costs: verification, reachability, impact, and fix-completeness. We present Drishti, an AI-led human-directed vulnerability audit framework with four components, one per cost: (i) an anti-pattern catalog for verification, (ii) critical-path triage for reachability, (iii) concentric validation for impact, and (iv) patch-review for fix-completeness. Across audits of Open5GS and free5GC, Drishti produced three findings. The first is a pre-authentication NULL-dereference in the Open5GS NRF multipart parser, fixed upstream with a CVE requested. The second is an ASN.1-PER memory amplification in the free5GC NGAP decoder. A 2-byte input from a rogue gNodeB OOM-kills the AMF in 6.2 seconds. The third is a defective patch on CVE-2025-69248 whose defense-in-depth check is dead code before authentication.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 Drishti 的、由 AI 主导但由人类指导的漏洞审计框架，针对开源 5G 核心网软件中漏洞验证与影响评估成本高昂的问题。作者指出，随着 AI 辅助代码审查的发展，生成候选缺陷已不再困难，真正的瓶颈在于验证和影响评估，尤其是在关键基础设施软件（如 5G 核心网）中。验证过程包含四种成本：验证（verification）、可达性（reachability）、影响（impact）和修复完整性（fix-completeness）。Drishti 框架由四个组件构成，分别对应上述成本：(i) 用于验证的反模式目录（anti-pattern catalog）；(ii) 用于可达性分析的关键路径分类（critical-path triage）；(iii) 用于影响评估的同心验证（concentric validation）；(iv) 用于修复完整性检查的补丁审查（patch-review）。作者对 Open5GS 和 free5GC 两个开源 5G 核心网项目进行了审计，取得了三项发现。第一项是 Open5GS 的 NRF（网络功能仓库功能）多部分解析器存在一个预认证的 NULL 指针解引用漏洞，该漏洞已在上游修复并申请了 CVE。第二项是 free5GC 的 NGAP 解码器中存在 ASN.1 PER（packed encoding rules）内存放大漏洞：来自恶意 gNodeB 的 2 字节输入可在 6.2 秒内导致 AMF（接入和移动性管理功能）进程因内存耗尽（OOM）而被杀死。第三项是 CVE-2025-69248 的修复补丁存在缺陷，其纵深防御检查在认证之前是死代码，无法真正发挥作用。该框架旨在降低人工验证成本，提高漏洞审计的效率和准确性，适合安全研究人员、5G 核心网维护者以及从事关键基础设施安全审计的蓝队人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 5G 核心网是国家级关键基础设施，漏洞可能导致大规模通信中断。该研究证明了 AI 辅助审计在真实 5G 开源项目中能发现可被远程利用的严重缺陷，为类似关键基础设施的漏洞验证提供了方法论参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响了 Open5GS 和 free5GC 两个主流开源 5G 核心网实现，其中 free5GC 的漏洞可被未认证的伪基站（gNodeB）远程触发，导致 AMF 崩溃，影响服务可用性。
detection_signals_zh: 针对 NRF 多部分解析器的异常请求，可能导致 NULL 指针解引用
NGAP 协议中异常短的 PER 编码数据包，可能引发内存过度分配
补丁中存在认证前不可达的检查逻辑，可被用于绕过修复
defense_advice_zh: 及时应用上游补丁，并确认补丁在认证路径前是否真正生效
对 5G 核心网控制平面接口（如 NRF、NGAP）实施严格的输入验证和资源限制
部署针对 OOM 异常退出和异常内存增长的实时监控与告警

items.title: Baserow 2.3.3 contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the index() formula function. A low-privileged authenticated user who can create or modify formula fields can provide an ...
items.summary:
Baserow 2.3.3 contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the index() formula function. A low-privileged authenticated user who can create or modify formula fields can provide an undocumented fourth argument that is treated as a SQL template and interpolated directly into a PostgreSQL expression.



The vulnerable expression is executed when Baserow recalculates formula field values. Because the generated SQL runs through Baserow's database connection, the injected SQL executes with the privileges of the Baserow PostgreSQL role rather than the permissions of the authenticated application user.



This issue affects Baserow: 2.3.3.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Baserow 2.3.3 版本被发现存在一个 SQL 注入漏洞，具体位于 index() 公式函数中。该漏洞允许低权限的已认证用户（具备创建或修改公式字段的权限）提供一个未记录的第四个参数，该参数会被当作 SQL 模板，并直接拼接到 PostgreSQL 表达式中。当 Baserow 为公式字段重新计算值时，这个易受攻击的表达式就会被执行。由于生成的 SQL 通过 Baserow 自有的数据库连接运行，注入的 SQL 将以 Baserow PostgreSQL 角色的权限执行，而不是认证应用用户的权限，因此攻击者可能获得超出其预期权限的数据库操作能力，例如读取或修改其他数据、执行管理员操作等。该问题影响 Baserow 2.3.3 版本。目前 NVD 未提供 CVSS 评分和 EPSS 数据，也未列入 KEV 或标记为在野利用。鉴于该漏洞可利用门槛较低（低权限认证用户）、影响范围可能涉及数据库机密性和完整性，风险等级评估为高。建议用户立即关注官方安全公告并升级到修复版本；若无法立即升级，应限制公式字段的创建/修改权限，收紧 PostgreSQL 账号的最小权限，并审计数据库查询日志以检测可疑行为。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 低权限用户即可触发 SQL 注入且以数据库角色执行，可导致敏感数据泄露、篡改或权限提升，需尽快升级修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可利用该漏洞执行任意 SQL 语句，造成数据泄露、数据篡改，甚至可能危及整个 PostgreSQL 数据库的安全。由于 Baserow 常被用于内部数据管理，风险会进一步放大。

items.why_it_matters: 低权限用户即可触发 SQL 注入且以数据库角色执行，可导致敏感数据泄露、篡改或权限提升，需尽快升级修复。

items.title: A security vulnerability has been detected in Piwigo up to 16.3.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file i.php of the component Image Derivative Handl...
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Piwigo up to 16.3.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file i.php of the component Image Derivative Handler. The manipulation leads to path traversal. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-84441 是针对 Piwigo 图片管理软件（版本 ≤16.3.0）的一个安全漏洞。该漏洞位于图像派生处理组件的 i.php 文件中，由于对文件路径的验证不充分，存在路径遍历问题。远程攻击者无需身份验证即可利用该漏洞，通过发送特制请求，可能读取服务器上的任意文件，甚至在某些条件下结合文件写入或上传功能造成更严重的影响。公开的漏洞描述未提供具体利用细节，但指出该漏洞已公开披露且可能被利用。CVSS 评分为 7.3，属于高危级别，反映其网络可利用性和低攻击复杂度的特点。目前厂商尚未发布官方补丁信息，因此受影响用户在未更新前应审慎限制对 Piwigo 应用及其相关接口的网络访问，并通过 Web 应用防火墙或服务器访问控制规则拦截可疑的目录穿越请求。同时，密切监视服务器日志，对异常路径或敏感文件读取请求保持警惕。由于该漏洞可能暴露配置文件、日志或用户数据，应当及时完成升级或应用缓解措施，以降低被实际利用的风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可被远程匿名利用，无需用户交互，可能造成敏感信息泄露。Piwigo 被广泛用于个人与机构图片库，风险面较大。由于利用细节已公开，建议 SOC 优先关注该系统资产并尽快修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能导致服务器上任意文件被读取，包括数据库配置、应用密钥等；若与后续利用链结合，也可能导致部分功能受影响或数据完整性下降。根据 CVSS，影响包括机密性、完整性、可用性均为低级别，对单个系统造成有限破坏，但因无需认证，风险不容忽视。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞可被远程匿名利用，无需用户交互，可能造成敏感信息泄露。Piwigo 被广泛用于个人与机构图片库，风险面较大。由于利用细节已公开，建议 SOC 优先关注该系统资产并尽快修复。

items.title: The WP File Download plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the delete function in all versions. This makes it...
items.summary: The WP File Download plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the delete function in all versions. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). The two-stage exploit requires a first request to the file.save task to persist the path-traversal string into file metadata, followed by a second request to the file.delete task to trigger the unlink call — both endpoints lack capability checks and nonce enforcement.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-14982 影响 WordPress 的 WP File Download 插件全版本。该插件存在任意文件删除漏洞，根因是 delete 功能对文件路径验证不足。攻击者只需拥有订阅者级别（subscriber-level）及以上的账户认证，即可利用此漏洞删除服务器上的任意文件。漏洞利用分为两个阶段：第一阶段向 file.save 任务发送请求，将路径遍历字符串持久化到文件元数据中；第二阶段再向 file.delete 任务发送请求，触发 unlink 调用删除目标文件。两个端点均缺少能力检查和 nonce 防护，导致身份验证要求很低。若攻击者删除关键文件（如 wp-config.php），可进一步导致远程代码执行，风险极高。CVSS 评分为 8.1（高危），攻击向量为网络，攻击复杂度低，所需权限低，无需用户交互，影响为完整性和可用性高影响（机密性无影响）。目前该漏洞尚未被列入已知被利用漏洞目录（KEV），也未标记为已在野利用。建议用户立即更新 WP File Download 插件到已修复版本，或暂时禁用该插件并限制相关端点的网络暴露，同时审查站点文件完整性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许低权限用户（订阅者）任意删除服务器文件，可删除 wp-config.php 等关键配置，极易导致站点被接管或 RCE，影响面覆盖插件全版本，需紧急处置。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可删除服务器上的任意文件，破坏站点完整性和可用性；若删除关键配置文件，可能进一步实现远程代码执行，导致完全控制服务器。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许低权限用户（订阅者）任意删除服务器文件，可删除 wp-config.php 等关键配置，极易导致站点被接管或 RCE，影响面覆盖插件全版本，需紧急处置。

items.title: FeatherPanel versions before 1.3.7.10 fail to validate permissions in the SubuserController updateSubuser handler, allowing authenticated subusers to modify their own permission...
items.summary: FeatherPanel versions before 1.3.7.10 fail to validate permissions in the SubuserController updateSubuser handler, allowing authenticated subusers to modify their own permission records. A subuser with minimal permissions can send a crafted request to grant themselves full server control, enabling unauthorized access to sensitive data, backups, and server configuration.

llm_summary.summary_zh: FeatherPanel 1.3.7.10 之前版本存在一个权限校验缺失漏洞。具体位置在 SubuserController 的 updateSubuser 处理器中，该处理器在更新子用户信息时未正确校验当前操作者的权限，导致已认证的子用户（即使只有最基础权限）可以通过构造特制请求来修改自身权限记录，从而将自身权限提升为完全服务器控制权限。攻击者利用此漏洞后，能够访问敏感数据、备份文件和服务器配置，并可能进一步造成服务器被完全接管、关键数据泄露或服务中断。此漏洞的 CVSS v3.1 评分为 8.8，属于高危漏洞，攻击复杂度低，无需用户交互，且可能对机密性、完整性和可用性造成高影响。NVD 已发布该 CVE 条目，但未提供受影响版本范围以外的厂商信息或具体产品列表。截至当前元数据，该漏洞尚未列入 KEV 目录，也没有明确标志表明已在野利用。建议所有使用 FeatherPanel 的用户尽快升级至 1.3.7.10 或更高版本，同时，在升级前临时限制子用户账号的访问来源并监控相关日志，以降低风险。由于该漏洞源于权限校验缺失，修复补丁应重点加强服务端对子用户操作的权限验证逻辑。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: FeatherPanel 的权限绕过允许低权限子用户自主提升至管理员级别，直接威胁服务器敏感数据和配置的机密性与完整性。CVSS 8.8，攻击门槛低，一旦被利用影响严重，需立即修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用此漏洞可使低权限子用户获得完全服务器控制权，导致敏感数据、备份和配置的未授权访问，影响数据的机密性、完整性和服务可用性。

items.why_it_matters: FeatherPanel 的权限绕过允许低权限子用户自主提升至管理员级别，直接威胁服务器敏感数据和配置的机密性与完整性。CVSS 8.8，攻击门槛低，一旦被利用影响严重，需立即修复。

items.title: APITable through 1.13.0-beta.1 exposes the internal organization loadOrSearch endpoint without authentication, allowing unauthenticated attackers to retrieve member names, email...
items.summary: APITable through 1.13.0-beta.1 exposes the internal organization loadOrSearch endpoint without authentication, allowing unauthenticated attackers to retrieve member names, email addresses, and team hierarchy. Attackers can query the endpoint with space identifiers obtained from shared links or public templates to enumerate the complete member directory of any workspace.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-84485 影响 APITable 1.13.0-beta.1 及之前版本。APITable 是一个开源多维表格/低代码平台。其内部组织端点“loadOrSearch”缺少身份验证保护，导致任何未认证攻击者都可以直接构造请求并访问该接口。攻击者只需从公开共享链接或公共模板中获取 workspace 的空间标识符，即可通过此接口枚举该工作空间的完整成员目录，包括成员姓名、电子邮箱地址以及团队层级关系。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 7.5，属于高危，攻击复杂度低，无需权限和用户交互，仅需网络访问即可利用。由于该端点本应供内部组织功能使用，错误地暴露在公共网络，造成敏感信息泄露。攻击者利用泄露的邮箱和人员信息，可进一步实施钓鱼攻击、账号撞库或社会工程攻击，从而扩大入侵面。目前官方尚未发布修复版本（截至信息提供时，受影响版本至 1.13.0-beta.1），建议用户保持关注并及时升级；同时，在补丁可用前，应通过防火墙或反向代理限制对该端点的外部访问，仅允许来自可信内部网络的请求，并启用认证中间件进行访问控制。需要强调，当前没有证据表明该漏洞已在野外被利用（KEV 为 False，在野利用标志为 False），但仍应重视资产暴露面并主动缓解风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞使未认证攻击者仅凭公开空间标识即可枚举任意工作空间的成员目录与邮箱，导致组织敏感信息泄露风险高。攻击者可借此发起鱼叉式钓鱼或社工攻击，影响企业供应链安全。在修复前建议隔离端点并加强认证。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 机密性影响严重——攻击者可获得组织成员姓名、邮件和团队结构的完整列表；可能引发内网渗透、垃圾邮件以及基于身份的诈骗活动。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞使未认证攻击者仅凭公开空间标识即可枚举任意工作空间的成员目录与邮箱，导致组织敏感信息泄露风险高。攻击者可借此发起鱼叉式钓鱼或社工攻击，影响企业供应链安全。在修复前建议隔离端点并加强认证。

items.title: ION-DTN versions before 4.2.0 contain an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the decodeSdnv function that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read memory by sending trunc...
items.summary: ION-DTN versions before 4.2.0 contain an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the decodeSdnv function that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read memory by sending truncated SDNV values. Attackers can send a UDP datagram to the LTP link service input port with a truncated SDNV to trigger reads up to nine bytes past buffer boundaries and underflow byte counters.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-84484 是 ION-DTN（延迟容忍网络实现）4.2.0 之前版本中存在的一个越界读取漏洞。该漏洞存在于 decodeSdnv 函数中，在处理截断的 SDNV（自描述数值）值时，未正确校验缓冲区边界。远程未认证攻击者可以通过向 LTP 链路服务输入端口发送精心构造的 UDP 数据报，传入截断的 SDNV，从而触发越界读取，最多可读取缓冲区边界外 9 字节的数据，并可能导致字节计数器下溢。CVSS 评分为 7.5，属于高严重性漏洞，攻击复杂度低，无需任何权限或用户交互，但影响仅限于可用性（A:H），不涉及机密性和完整性。由于该漏洞可被远程未认证利用，存在被利用造成服务异常或信息泄漏的风险。当前没有证据表明该漏洞已被在野利用或列入 KEV 目录。建议受影响用户尽快升级到 ION-DTN 4.2.0 或更高版本以修复该问题；在无法立即升级的情况下，应限制对 LTP 服务端口的网络访问，仅允许可信来源连接，以降低暴露面。此外，建议监控相关服务日志，警惕异常 UDP 流量。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许远程未认证攻击者触发越界读取并影响系统可用性，且攻击复杂度低。ION-DTN 常用于深空/容断网络，相关服务可能暴露于不可信网络，建议优先升级并收敛暴露面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 远程攻击者可通过发送截断 SDNV 的 UDP 数据报，触发越界读取（最多越界 9 字节）并导致字节计数器下溢，可能引发服务崩溃或异常，属高可用性影响。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许远程未认证攻击者触发越界读取并影响系统可用性，且攻击复杂度低。ION-DTN 常用于深空/容断网络，相关服务可能暴露于不可信网络，建议优先升级并收敛暴露面。

items.title: A vulnerability was determined in OpenCart 4.1.0.3/4.1.0.4. This affects an unknown function of the file catalog/controller/account/edit.php of the component Autocomplete Workfl...
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in OpenCart 4.1.0.3/4.1.0.4. This affects an unknown function of the file catalog/controller/account/edit.php of the component Autocomplete Workflow. This manipulation of the argument firstname causes cross site scripting. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-84438 是 OpenCart 4.1.0.3 和 4.1.0.4 版本中一个已公开披露的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞。漏洞位于 catalog/controller/account/edit.php 文件中，归属于 Autocomplete Workflow 组件。攻击者通过构造特殊的 firstname 参数，可在目标用户的浏览器会话中执行恶意脚本。该漏洞依赖远程触发，但根据 CVSS 向量，攻击者需要拥有低权限账户（PR:L），且受害者需要与恶意构造的页面或链接交互（UI:R），攻击复杂度较低（AC:L）。成功利用后，可导致页面内容被篡改，但不涉及机密信息泄露，仅产生低影响的完整性破坏。漏洞描述指出，该漏洞的利用方法已公开，可能被攻击者实际利用。开发者曾被告知漏洞信息，但未收到任何回应，这意味着在撰写本摘要时，官方可能尚未发布修复补丁。根据元数据评估，该漏洞尚未被纳入已知被利用漏洞目录（KEV），也没有明确证据表明已在真实环境被利用。考虑到其攻击前提为已登录的低权限用户并需要交互，实际风险相对有限，但考虑到 OpenCart 的广泛部署，仍建议管理员尽快核实并采取缓解措施。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许低权限用户经交互触发 XSS，在后台管理或用户账户场景中可能导致会话劫持、恶意操作或钓鱼页面注入。漏洞细节已公开，存在被武器化利用的可能，且官方无响应，属实际威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致受害者的浏览器执行任意脚本，进而篡改页面、窃取会话 Cookie（若 HttpOnly 未开启）、执行受限操作或诱导用户执行恶意动作。由于需要用户交互且未造成机密性损失，综合危害有限，但仍影响系统完整性。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许低权限用户经交互触发 XSS，在后台管理或用户账户场景中可能导致会话劫持、恶意操作或钓鱼页面注入。漏洞细节已公开，存在被武器化利用的可能，且官方无响应，属实际威胁。

items.title: A vulnerability was found in OpenCart 4.1.0.3/4.1.0.4. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file catalog/controller/account/address.php of the component Autocomple...
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in OpenCart 4.1.0.3/4.1.0.4. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file catalog/controller/account/address.php of the component Autocomplete Workflow. The manipulation of the argument address_1 results in cross site scripting. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

llm_summary.summary_zh: OpenCart 4.1.0.3 与 4.1.0.4 版本被披露存在一个跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，位于前台账户地址控制器文件 catalog/controller/account/address.php 的自动补全工作流中。攻击者可操纵 address_1 参数注入恶意内容，远程发起攻击。该漏洞要求攻击者具备低权限用户身份，且受害者需进行交互（如点击恶意链接），CVSS 评分为 3.5（低危）。尽管评分不高，但攻击向量为网络可利用，可能影响数据的完整性。目前漏洞利用方法已被公开，厂商虽被提前通知但未做出回应，意味着尚未有官方补丁或修复版本。由于未列入 CISA KEV 且没有明确在野利用标记，无法确认实际攻击活动，但利用细节公开已增加被利用风险。受影响组件为前台账户地址功能，成功的 XSS 可导致在受害用户浏览器中执行任意脚本，诱骗操作、劫持会话或篡改页面内容。蓝队应视其为潜在风险，优先采用防护性缓解措施，例如限制该路径的外部访问、部署 WAF 规则、监控异常请求，并持续关注厂商动向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: OpenCart 为广泛使用的电商平台，该 XSS 位于前台账户流程，攻击面可达。利用代码已公开，官方未响应修复，若暴露公网则实际风险较高，可能影响管理员及用户会话安全。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致在受害者浏览器中执行任意脚本，造成会话令牌窃取、账户操作、页面篡改等连带风险。尽管 CVSS 较低，但攻击可远程发起，且无需特殊权限（仅需低权限），若与管理员交互则可能升级为更严重的影响。

items.title: A vulnerability was detected in AirAsia MOVE App up to 12.47.1 on Android. This issue affects the function com.airasia.core.utils.RealPathUtil.getRealPath of the component com.a...
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in AirAsia MOVE App up to 12.47.1 on Android. This issue affects the function com.airasia.core.utils.RealPathUtil.getRealPath of the component com.airasia.mobile. Performing a manipulation of the argument _display_name results in path traversal. The attack requires a local approach. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本次漏洞影响 AirAsia MOVE App 在 Android 平台上发布的所有版本（最高至 12.47.1）。漏洞位于 com.airasia.mobile 组件的 com.airasia.core.utils.RealPathUtil.getRealPath 方法中，问题根源是应用对外部传入的文件名字段（_display_name）缺乏充分的过滤与规范化处理，导致攻击者有可能在该函数中嵌入路径穿越片段（如 ../），使最终解析的文件路径越出预期目录范围，形成路径遍历。从攻击条件看，该漏洞需要本地访问能力，攻击者通常需要先获得设备上的低权限进程或能够向目标应用提交恶意输入，才可触发；攻击过程无需用户交互。CVSS v3.1 评分为 4.4（中危），向量为 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:L。由于漏洞只影响完整性（L）和可用性（L），保密性不受影响，因此实际破坏程度被限制在应用自身沙盒相关文件及内部存储范围内。披露信息显示利用代码已经公开（The exploit is now public），攻击者自行利用的技术门槛降低，但输入数据中并未标记已在野利用（exploit_in_the_wild=false），也未列入 KEV，故不能断言已有野外攻击活动。厂商方面，CVE 描述明确表示联系厂商后未获回应，这意味着短期内可能没有官方补丁。综合考虑，用户应持续关注 AirAsia 官方安全公告，并在有条件时升级到后续修复版本；若暂无新版本，则需加强移动设备的本地访问控制、避免安装来源不明的应用、关闭不必要的高权限开关，并关注应用的运行状态以发现异常。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞涉及流行出行应用，且利用代码已公开，需特别关注。虽然攻击要求本地低权限访问，限制了远程大规模利用，但一旦攻击者接触设备，可影响应用完整性与可用性；厂商未回应导致临时修复缺失，用户应加强设备管控。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 根据 CVSS 3.1 评估（AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:L），漏洞允许低权限的本地攻击者在受影响的 AirAsia MOVE App 中触发路径遍历，对应用自身的完整性和可用性造成低程度影响（例如覆盖/删除目标文件或访问受限路径），不会直接导致机密性泄露。由于该移动应用功能涉及旅行票务等个人信息，实际利用可能导致部分数据损坏或服务不可用。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞涉及流行出行应用，且利用代码已公开，需特别关注。虽然攻击要求本地低权限访问，限制了远程大规模利用，但一旦攻击者接触设备，可影响应用完整性与可用性；厂商未回应导致临时修复缺失，用户应加强设备管控。

items.title: A flaw was found in the first-broker-login flow of the Keycloak identity management service. When a user links a social identity provider account to their local account, the ver...
items.summary: A flaw was found in the first-broker-login flow of the Keycloak identity management service. When a user links a social identity provider account to their local account, the verification proof generated is not strictly bound to the specific upstream identity being verified. This allows an attacker with a different account on the same social provider to intercept the process and link their own account to the victim's local profile, gaining unauthorized access.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于Keycloak身份管理服务的首次代理登录（first-broker-login）流程中。当用户将社交身份提供者（IdP）账户关联到本地账户时，系统生成的验证凭证并未严格绑定到正在验证的特定上游身份。具体而言，该证明未在密码学上或逻辑上锁定到发起认证请求的社交账户，导致同一社交提供者上的其他账户持有者可以利用此弱点干扰链接流程。攻击者若能拦截或控制认证过程中的某些步骤（需要网络访问、一定交互条件和低权限），便可将其自身的社交账户链接到受害者的本地配置文件，进而在未经授权的情况下以受害者身份访问受保护资源。该问题的影响范围涉及机密性和完整性的高损失，但可利用条件较复杂，CVSS评分为6.4（AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N）。目前未提供具体的受影响产品版本和厂商信息，也未列入KEV或标记为在野利用。建议受影响的Keycloak部署优先关注官方安全公告与补丁更新，及时升级到修复版本。在无法立即修补时，应限制管理控制台和认证端点的网络暴露，并监控异常的账户链接活动。由于该漏洞涉及身份认证与账户绑定，风险等级中等偏高，建议安全团队将其纳入优先处置清单。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可致攻击者抢占受害者的账户关联流程，实现未授权访问，威胁身份边界完整性。即便利用条件复杂，也能导致高机密性与完整性损失，需及时修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可将其社交账户绑定至受害者本地账户，从而绕过正常认证，获得受害者账户的访问权限，造成数据泄露或业务篡改。

items.title: facefusion through 3.6.1 fails to normalize job identifiers in get_job_file_name, allowing attackers to write files outside the jobs directory. Attackers can supply traversal se...
items.summary: facefusion through 3.6.1 fails to normalize job identifiers in get_job_file_name, allowing attackers to write files outside the jobs directory. Attackers can supply traversal sequences in the job identifier parameter through the unauthenticated HTTP API to create files at arbitrary locations.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-84702 是 facefusion（一个开源的深度学习面部交换工具）中存在的路径遍历漏洞，影响版本直至 3.6.1。漏洞根源在于 get_job_file_name 函数对作业标识符（job identifier）未进行规范化处理，使得攻击者能够利用包含 ../ 等遍历序列的输入绕过目录限制。具体触发方式为：通过 facefusion 提供的未经过身份验证的 HTTP API，向作业标识符参数中注入恶意路径，即可将上传或生成的文件写入作业目录之外的任意位置。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 7.5（高危），攻击向量为网络，攻击复杂度低，无需任何权限，且无需用户交互。安全影响主要体现在完整性方面为高，即攻击者能够在服务器上创建、修改或覆盖任意文件，可能进一步导致服务配置被篡改、恶意脚本被写入 Web 目录或启动脚本，甚至为远程代码执行创造条件，而机密性和可用性不受直接影响。由于接口无需认证，任何可访问受影响主机端口的远程攻击者都可尝试利用。截至此次分析，NVD 已收录该漏洞，但官方尚未发布修复补丁（或本元数据未包含该信息）。受影响产品的具体范围与厂商信息暂未提供。建议受影响用户立即采取缓解措施：若官方发布修复版本应优先升级；在无法升级时，应限制服务的网络暴露范围，避免将未认证的 API 暴露于公开网络；同时可从应用层实施输入过滤和路径规范化，或借助 Web 应用防火墙拦截路径穿越攻击。安全团队还应关注服务器上的异常文件写入行为，以进行检测与响应。综上，该漏洞利用条件简单、可能造成较严重破坏，建议给予高优先级处理。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 此漏洞利用门槛低，未认证远程攻击者可通过路径遍历在服务器任意位置写入文件，破坏系统完整性与可用性，甚至导致远程代码执行。CVSS 7.5 高危，需优先修复并限制暴露面。

items.title: NocoBase fails to sanitize rich text field values in the read renderer, allowing users with create permissions to store malicious HTML with event handlers. Attackers can write a...
items.summary: NocoBase fails to sanitize rich text field values in the read renderer, allowing users with create permissions to store malicious HTML with event handlers. Attackers can write arbitrary markup through the collection API that executes in the browsers of all users viewing the affected record.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-84701 是 NocoBase 中的一个存储型跨站脚本(XSS)漏洞。NocoBase 是一个低代码数据管理平台,其“读取渲染器”在处理富文本字段时,未对保存的 HTML 内容进行安全净化。这使得凡是拥有该平台“创建”权限的已认证用户,都可以通过 collection API 将携带事件处理器的恶意 HTML 写入到数据记录中。当其他用户(包括管理员)在页面上查看该记录时,恶意脚本即随内容渲染并在浏览器中执行。该漏洞的根因是服务端对输入处理和输出渲染的双重欠净化,且由于富文本内容通常被持久化存储,一旦注入,便可能长期潜伏于业务数据中。CVSS 3.1 基础评分为 5.4,向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N,表示攻击路径为网络,攻击复杂度低,需要低权限账户且须诱导用户交互,影响范围从受限环境扩展到相邻/后续组件,对机密性和完整性有低度影响。尽管整体评分定为中等,但考虑到此类漏洞在低代码开发环境中可被内部低权限用户低成本利用,并可借助浏览器渲染将影响传导给数据查看者,管理者应将修复该漏洞列入优先处理项。当前建议的处理措施包括:升级 NocoBase 至修复版本;在无法升级时,限制具有创建权限的用户范围;关闭或替换富文本渲染组件;并在 Web 服务层实施输入校验与 CSP(内容安全策略)防护,以缓解存储型 XSS 带来的风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许具备创建权限的低权限用户向数据中投毒,当管理员或高权限用户浏览该数据时,恶意脚本可在其浏览器上下文中执行,从而绕过访问控制,扩大数据泄露面并可能导致内网横向渗透。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 存储型 XSS 可能导致会话劫持、敏感信息窃取、页面篡改等。由于恶意内容持久化于记录,所有查看该记录的用户都会在不知不觉中执行脚本,形成广泛的横向影响。

items.title: PikiwiDB (Pika) v3.5.7 exposes an internal protobuf replication server on a port derived from the client port plus 2000 (e.g. 11221 when the default client port 9221 is used) th...
items.summary: PikiwiDB (Pika) v3.5.7 exposes an internal protobuf replication server on a port derived from the client port plus 2000 (e.g. 11221 when the default client port 9221 is used) that does not authenticate incoming requests. Although requirepass is intended to gate replication — a slave presents it as masterauth inside its MetaSync request — only the MetaSync handler (HandleMetaSyncRequest) validates it; the frame dispatcher (DealMessage) does not require a completed or attempted MetaSync before routing other message types to their handlers. As a result, an unauthenticated remote attacker can connect directly to the replication port and issue TrySync, DBSync, BinlogSync, and RemoveSlaveNode requests, obtaining the full-sync snapshot and live write stream and removing replica nodes, even when requirepass is configured.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-84700 涉及 PikiwiDB (Pika) v3.5.7 的复制服务认证绕过漏洞。该版本在客户端默认端口 (9221) +2000 的 TCP 端口（如11221）上监听内部 protobuf 复制服务，用于主从同步。该复制服务对传入请求不进行身份验证。设计上，requirepass 用于复制路径的安全保护：从节点必须在 MetaSync 请求中携带 masterauth 密码以供校验。然而，代码实现中仅 HandleMetaSyncRequest 处理器执行密码验证，而框架的消息分发函数 DealMessage 并不要求请求方先完成或尝试 MetaSync，即可将其他消息类型路由到各自处理器。因此，即使实例配置了 requirepass，任何能访问该复制端口的未认证远程攻击者，都可以直接发送 TrySync、DBSync、BinlogSync 和 RemoveSlaveNode 等控制消息。成功利用后，攻击者可获取主库的全量同步快照（可能包含所有数据）以及实时写入的 binlog 流，导致敏感数据大规模泄露；同时，攻击者还可以移除从节点，破坏复制拓扑，引发高可用性故障和数据同步中断。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 8.6，属于高危。目前 NVD 元数据未提供受影响产品范围及厂商信息，也未表示该漏洞已被在野利用或列入 KEV。建议用户优先关注官方补丁与升级信息，在无法立即升级时，通过防火墙或安全组严格限制复制端口仅对可信的内部复制节点开放，并对该端口的访问进行监控。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许未认证攻击者直接读取 PikiwiDB 的全量数据和实时写入流，并操纵复制拓扑。即便配置了 requirepass 也无法防护，影响数据机密性与服务可用性，且攻击门槛低（远程、无需凭据）。CVSS 8.6 高危，应优先处置。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 数据泄露（全量同步快照和实时 binlog 暴露）、复制节点可被任意移除导致同步中断，破坏高可用；可能造成服务不可用和敏感信息丢失。CVSS 8.6。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许未认证攻击者直接读取 PikiwiDB 的全量数据和实时写入流，并操纵复制拓扑。即便配置了 requirepass 也无法防护，影响数据机密性与服务可用性，且攻击门槛低（远程、无需凭据）。CVSS 8.6 高危，应优先处置。

items.title: PX4 Autopilot contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the sd_bench command that writes a four-byte block number into a user-supplied sized allocation. Attackers can inv...
items.summary: PX4 Autopilot contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the sd_bench command that writes a four-byte block number into a user-supplied sized allocation. Attackers can invoke sd_bench with a block size below four bytes to overflow the heap buffer and potentially execute code or crash the system.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-84698 是 PX4 Autopilot（开源自动驾驶仪软件）中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞。该漏洞存在于 sd_bench 命令中，该命令用于执行SD卡性能基准测试。具体来说，当用户（或攻击者）调用 sd_bench 并指定一个小于4字节的块大小（block size）时，代码会将一个4字节的块号写入用户提供大小的缓冲区，导致堆缓冲区溢出。这个溢出可能允许攻击者破坏相邻堆数据，进而导致代码执行或系统崩溃。CVSS 评分为6.5，攻击向量为相邻网络（AV:A），攻击复杂度低（AC:L），无需特权（PR:N）和用户交互（UI:N），影响仅限可用性（A:H），不影响机密性和完整性。EPSS 分数未提供，且该漏洞未被列入 CISA KEV 目录，也没有在野利用的明确报告。厂商和受影响产品列表暂未提供，但根据漏洞位置，影响PX4 Autopilot的某些版本。目前没有来自官方渠道的补丁信息。建议采取措施：监控官方安全公告，及时更新到包含修复的版本；限制对 sd_bench 命令的访问，仅允许授权用户使用；若该设备暴露在相邻网络，应评估风险并适当隔离。由于这是一处内存安全问题，攻击者可能通过恶意操作导致系统不稳定，在高度安全的环境中应优先处理。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞是内存破坏类问题，可能被用来导致飞行控制系统崩溃甚至远程代码执行，涉及无人航空器安全，具有较高的现实风险；由于CVSS仅影响可用性，但仍需重视。

items.title: Mailpit's IsInternalIP deny list function fails to block the Azure WireServer address 168.63.129.16 and the RFC 2765/6145 IPv4-translated IPv6 prefix, allowing server-side reque...
items.summary: Mailpit's IsInternalIP deny list function fails to block the Azure WireServer address 168.63.129.16 and the RFC 2765/6145 IPv4-translated IPv6 prefix, allowing server-side request forgery to internal destinations. Attackers can supply hostnames resolving to these addresses in message content to reach the link check API and proxy endpoint for accessing internal resources.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-84697 是 Mailpit 中一个与服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）相关的安全漏洞。Mailpit 的 IsInternalIP 函数本应通过黑名单方式阻止用户访问内部网络地址，但该函数未能正确屏蔽两个特定的内部地址范围：一是 Azure WireServer 的地址 168.63.129.16，二是 RFC 2765/6145 中定义的 IPv4 转换 IPv6 前缀（即 IPv4 嵌入 IPv6 地址）。攻击者可在消息内容中提供解析到这些地址的主机名，从而绕过内部地址防护，触发 Mailpit 的链接检查 API 和代理端点，进而访问内部资源。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 5.3（中危），攻击向量为网络，攻击复杂度低，无需特权且无需用户交互，影响仅限于机密性（低），不涉及完整性和可用性。由于 Mailpit 常用于开发或测试环境中的邮件审查与链接预览，若部署在可被外部访问的位置，攻击者可能借此探测内网信息或访问仅限内部的服务。目前该漏洞未被列入 KEV 目录，也没有明确证据表明已在野利用，因此不应将其视为紧急利用威胁，但考虑到 Mailpit 可能暴露在不可信网络中，建议相关用户关注官方补丁或安全公告。缓解措施包括：尽快将 Mailpit 升级至修复该问题的版本；若无法立即升级，应限制 Mailpit 服务仅对可信网络开放，并避免将链接检查或代理功能暴露给不受信的用户；对出站请求进行额外过滤，确保无法访问上述特定内部地址。建议网络和安全团队在资产清单中标记该组件，评估实际暴露面，并定期检查访问日志中是否有针对这些地址的异常请求。总体而言，这是一个需要关注但并非紧急的 SSRF 漏洞，主要价值在于提醒运维人员修正内部地址过滤逻辑的盲区。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞暴露了 SSRF 防护中常见的关键盲区：对云平台链路地址和 IPv6 转换前缀的过滤缺失。攻击者可借此访问内部资源，造成信息泄露。Mailpit 若暴露于不可信网络，风险会显著上升，应及时修复或限制访问。

items.title: Phison PS3111-S11 controller firmware versions through SBFQT1.3 expose privileged vendor unique commands over the ATA interface with absent or defeatable authentication mechanis...
items.summary: Phison PS3111-S11 controller firmware versions through SBFQT1.3 expose privileged vendor unique commands over the ATA interface with absent or defeatable authentication mechanisms. Attackers can bypass the weak CRC-16 based unlock handshake or exploit builds with no VUC lock to read and write controller memory and raw flash, persisting implants across power cycles.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-84696 是 Phison PS3111-S11 固态硬盘控制器固件（版本至 SBFQT1.3）中发现的高危漏洞。该控制器广泛用于多个品牌的消费级 SSD。问题在于固件通过 ATA 接口暴露了特权“厂商唯一命令”（VUC），但身份验证机制缺失或可被绕过。部分版本的解锁握手仅使用基于 CRC-16 的弱校验，另一些版本甚至未启用 VUC 锁；因此具备本地访问能力（如可连接 SATA 的调试接口）的攻击者有可能绕过保护，直接读写控制器内存和原始 NAND 闪存。这种级别的访问意味着攻击者可以在固件或底层存储中嵌入持久化代码，即使设备断电重启，恶意负载依然存在，形成难以清除的固件后门。该漏洞的 CVSS v3.1 评分为 8.2，攻击向量为本地（AV:L），攻击复杂度低（AC:L），需要高权限（PR:H），无需用户交互（UI:N），但影响范围可跨越安全域（S:C），对机密性、完整性、可用性均产生高影响（C:H/I:H/A:H）。目前没有公开信息表明该漏洞已被在野利用，也未被列入 CISA 已知被利用漏洞（KEV）列表。缓解措施应以更新固件为主，厂商需发布修复版本；同时应限制对受影响设备的物理访问和调试端口暴露。安全团队应盘点使用相关控制器的硬件资产，跟踪厂商安全公告，并在未完成修复前避免将设备置于不受信任的物理环境中。此外，由于该漏洞位于固件层面，常规杀毒软件难以感知，增大了防护难度。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 此漏洞使具有物理或本地访问权的攻击者能够完全控制固态硬盘控制器，读写任意内存与闪存，进而植入跨重启存活的固件后门。固件层恶意软件极难被安全软件发现，可能导致敏感数据泄露、系统持久化受控，对供应链安全和物理隔离环境构成直接威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用后，攻击者可窃取数据、篡改存储内容，并在固件级别植入持久后门，导致系统完全受控且难以清理。CVSS 向量显示机密性、完整性、可用性均告失守，并可能影响连接的其他资源；同时攻击不需要用户交互，实际风险较高。

items.title: Who Judges the Judges? A Chinese Safety QA Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Responses and Safety Judges
items.summary: Safety benchmarks for large language models often assess the risk of a user query, although the outcome of question answering depends on whether the response violates a policy. This distinction is critical in Chinese harmful-content evaluation, where linguistic variation and adversarial transformations can obscure risky intent. We introduce C-SafeQA, a policy-grounded benchmark for response-level Chinese safety evaluation. It comprises 538 base queries and 8,877 adversarial queries answered by four full-model LLM deployments, yielding 37,660 query-response records labeled safe, unsafe, or disputed. Reference labels are generated through agreement-aware multi-model adjudication and blind audits of stratified subsets by three safety experts. C-SafeQA supports both evaluation of target-model safety and auditing of seven automated safety judges against shared reference labels. Unsafe-response rates range from 0.93% to 3.35% on base queries and from 11.68% to 30.05% on adversarial queries. On the adversarial subset, judges show substantial trade-offs between unsafe-response recall and risk-query-conditioned safe-response false positive rate, and no judge dominates all metrics. Both acrostic transformations reduce unsafe recall for all seven judges, revealing mechanism-specific evaluator weaknesses. Dataset records, metadata, verification code, and judge scripts are publicly released to support recomputation, while benchmark construction, target-response generation, and private adjudication remain outside the release boundary.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 C-SafeQA，一个面向中文安全评估的、基于策略的响应级基准测试。现有的大语言模型安全基准大多评估用户查询本身的风险程度，但问答的实际安全性取决于模型响应是否违反内容政策。在中文有害内容评估中，这一区别尤为关键，因为语言变体和对抗性改写可能掩盖查询的恶意意图。C-SafeQA 包含 538 个基础查询和 8,877 个对抗性查询，由四个完整模型部署进行回答，共生成 37,660 条查询-响应记录，并标注为安全、不安全或存在争议。参考标签通过一致感知的多模型裁决和三位安全专家对分层子集的盲审生成。该基准既支持对目标模型安全性的评估，也支持在共享参考标签下审计七个自动化安全评判器。实验显示，在基础查询上不安全响应率为 0.93% 至 3.35%，在对抗性查询上为 11.68% 至 30.05%。在对抗性子集上，评判器在不安全响应召回率和风险查询条件下的安全响应误报率之间存在显著权衡，没有任何单一评判器在所有指标上占优。藏头诗等变换会降低所有七个评判器的不安全召回率，暴露出机制特定的评估弱点。数据集记录、元数据、验证代码和评判器脚本已公开，以支持结果复算，但基准构建、目标响应生成和私有裁决不在发布范围内。该工作适用于安全评估研究者、模型开发者和内容审核系统设计者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准首次聚焦中文响应级安全性，并系统评估自动化安全评判器的可靠性，揭示现有评判器在对抗性改写下的显著弱点，为中文内容安全评估和模型红队测试提供重要参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至中文内容审核系统评估、大模型安全对齐测试、自动化安全评判器的鲁棒性检测场景。

items.title: Delegation Without Trust: An Empirical Gap Analysis of Identity, Authorization, and Runtime Governance in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
items.summary: Autonomous LLM agents increasingly act on a user's behalf: they hold credentials, call tools and services, and spawn sub-agents that act further on their behalf. This turns a long-standing distributed-systems question -- who is authorized to do what, on whose authority -- into an urgent and largely unsolved problem, because the component driving each agent is a language model an adversary can hijack. We argue that agent security must be evaluated under an untrusted-model assumption: a correct system is one in which a fully prompt-injected agent still cannot exceed the authority explicitly delegated to it. Against this standard we make three contributions. First, we give a threat model for multi-agent delegation centered on four adversaries -- confused deputy, token theft and replay, prompt-injection privilege escalation, and compromised sub-agents -- and derive eight security requirements a governed agent system must meet. Second, we show the gap is real: a default agent runtime modeling common practice (broad bearer credentials, authorization gated inside the model) fails all four threats, and across four widely used frameworks -- LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) authorization model -- three provide no built-in confinement and one only partial; no existing standard alone covers the requirement set. Third, we implement and adversarially evaluate an authorization broker that closes the gap. It blocks all four threats; it resists 11 direct attacks on its design and accepts 0 of 200,000 forged tokens; it confines a compromised sub-agent to its delegated task (a mean of 1.5 reachable actions versus all 8,100 under bearer delegation, across 2,000 randomized scenarios); and it enforces at microsecond cost (about 2.6 microseconds per decision), negligible against model inference. These principles are also realized in production in VotalAI's LLM Shield.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统中的授权与运行时治理问题展开研究。作者指出，自主 LLM 智能体日益代表用户持有凭证、调用工具与服务，并能派生子智能体进一步行动，这使得分布式系统中经典的“谁被授权做什么、依据谁的授权”问题变得紧迫且基本未解决，因为驱动每个智能体的组件是可被对手劫持的语言模型。作者提出“不可信模型假设”：一个安全的系统应当保证，即使智能体被完全提示注入，也无法超越被显式授予的权限。基于该标准，论文有三项贡献：第一，构建了针对多智能体委托的威胁模型，聚焦四种对手——混乱的代理、令牌窃取与重放、提示注入特权提升、失陷子智能体，并推导出受治理智能体系统必须满足的八项安全要求；第二，通过实验证明现实差距：模拟常见实践的默认智能体运行时（广泛承载凭证、模型内部授权）在全部四种威胁下均失效；在 LangGraph、CrewAI、AutoGen 和模型上下文协议（MCP）授权模型这四个广泛使用的框架中，三个没有内置隔离机制，一个仅部分满足；现有标准单独均无法覆盖全部要求；第三，作者实现并对抗性评估了一个授权代理（authorization broker），它能阻断全部四种威胁：抵抗了对其设计的 11 次直接攻击，拒绝了 200,000 个伪造令牌中的全部；在 2,000 个随机场景中，能将失陷子智能体限制在其被委托的任务上（平均仅可触达 1.5 个操作，而承载委托可达 8,100 个）；并以微秒级开销强制执行（每个决策约 2.6 微秒），相比模型推理时间可忽略。这些原则已在 VotalAI 的 LLM Shield 产品中实现。论文面向 LLM 安全、多智能体系统设计者和安全架构师，提供了从威胁建模到实际防御的完整方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 明确了 LLM 智能体委托场景中的安全边界，提出“不可信模型”标准，揭示了主流框架（LangGraph、CrewAI、AutoGen、MCP）缺乏内置隔离的严重问题，对设计安全的自主智能体系统具有直接指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有涉及 LLM 智能体自主调用工具、持有凭证、动态委派子任务的系统，如企业自动化、MCP 生态、多智能体协作平台。若不加治理，易导致越权、数据泄露或横向移动。
detection_signals_zh: 检测异常的子智能体创建或委派链，尤其是越权访问资源的行为
监控令牌使用模式，识别重放或伪造的可疑授权请求
跟踪模型输入中的提示注入特征，尤其是试图提升权限的指令
defense_advice_zh: 采用“不可信模型假设”，默认认为智能体可能被完全劫持，最小化授权范围
部署独立于模型之外的授权代理，将权限判定从模型推理中剥离，实施集中式策略校验
对令牌实行短时效、细粒度、绑定上下文的机制，避免承载式长期凭证
对子智能体实施任务级隔离，限制其可触达的操作和资源
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: SIR: Self-improving Red-teaming for Compute Use Agents
items.summary: Computer use agents (CUAs) are vision-language models that perceive a screen and act on a real operating system through mouse, keyboard, and terminal, and they are increasingly deployed to automate everyday digital tasks. Because they can be exposed to untrusted content while operating, they are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI), in which an adversary plants instructions in content the agent will read and redirects it toward actions that violate the user's intent. Existing CUA safety benchmarks evaluate fixed injections written by hand, which may underestimate the risk posed by an adaptive adversary. We present SIR, a black box IPI attack that (i) composes stealthy injections from a small library of reusable principles stated in plain language and (ii) wraps composition in an iterative feedback loop that diagnoses the victim's failed trajectories and distills the bypasses into new, named strategies that are reapplied across tasks. Unlike prior red teaming of web agents, we target CUAs at the operating system level and score attacks with a fully deterministic oracle, using checks on filesystem, service, and permission state rather than an LLM judge. On experiment, we evaluate three frontier CUAs. Composing principles with feedback raises the attack success rate over a baseline written by hand, for example from 4% to 24% on Claude Opus 4.8 and from 0% to 28% on Gemini 3.5 Flash, while the benign task still completes. Principles discovered against one model further transfer to a different architecture with no additional feedback.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 SIR（Self-improving Red-teaming）的黑盒攻击方法，用于针对计算机使用代理（Computer Use Agents, CUAs）进行间接提示注入（Indirect Prompt Injection, IPI）测试。CUAs 是基于视觉-语言模型的智能体，能够感知屏幕并通过鼠标、键盘和终端与真实操作系统交互，正逐渐被用于自动化日常数字任务。由于 CUAs 在运行时可能接触不可信内容，攻击者可在其读取的内容中植入恶意指令，使其执行违背用户意图的操作。现有的 CUA 安全基准多使用人工编写的固定注入样本，难以充分反映自适应攻击者的真实威胁。SIR 方法包含两个核心机制：一是从可复用的自然语言原则库中组合出隐蔽的注入策略；二是通过迭代反馈循环，分析受害模型失败的轨迹，将成功绕过的方法蒸馏为新的命名策略，并跨任务复用。与以往针对 Web 代理的红队测试不同，SIR 专注于操作系统级别的 CUA，并使用完全确定性的验证器——通过检查文件系统、服务和权限状态而非 LLM 评判来评估攻击是否成功。实验在三个前沿 CUA 模型上进行，结果显示，结合反馈组合原则能显著提升攻击成功率：例如 Claude Opus 4.8 上从人工基线的 4% 提升至 24%，Gemini 3.5 Flash 上从 0% 提升至 28%，同时良性任务仍能完成。此外，针对一个模型发现的绕过原则能够迁移到另一个不同架构的模型，且无需额外反馈。该研究揭示了当前 CUA 在面临自适应注入攻击时的脆弱性，并为构建更鲁棒的安全评测体系提供了新方向。适合关注 LLM 智能体安全、红队测试及安全评测的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: CUA 正被广泛部署，IPI 攻击威胁真实。该研究证明了人工固定基准会低估风险，自适应自动化红队可高效发现可利用漏洞，对智能体安全设计有重要警示意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于任何基于视觉语言模型的计算机使用代理，影响 ChromeOS 等系统级自动化场景，可迁移到对 Web 代理或 RPA 工具的 IPI 防护评估。

同一模型在重复任务中出现异常行为模式，且可跨会话复现
defense_advice_zh: 在模型输入输出链路中增加提示注入检测器，重点识别具有命令指导性的隐性指令
对 CUA 的关键操作实施最小权限控制与人工确认机制，尤其是权限提升或数据删除类动作
建立自适应红队评测流程，定期使用原则库组合与反馈迭代方式测试内部模型

items.title: The Fragility of Jailbreak Robustness Across Operational States
items.summary: Existing jailbreak evaluations typically characterize robustness using a single attack success rate (ASR) measured in a default configuration (the vanilla state). However, user-LLM interactions can induce diverse operational states beyond the vanilla state. In this work, we find that jailbreak robustness is highly fragile to operational-state variation: even when the attack remains fixed, changing only an ordinary system prompt not designed to affect safety can dramatically alter attack success rates. We systematically investigate this phenomenon across seven aligned models and three representative jailbreak attacks, observing substantial differences in ASR between vanilla and non-vanilla operational states. In one case, ASR increases by up to 56 percentage points (2% to 58%) solely due to a change in operational state. Remarkably, these increases occur even for attacks originally designed and optimized under vanilla-state evaluation. We further show that state-dependent robustness variation is systematically associated with differences in hidden representations along a refusal-related axis, and that projections onto this axis strongly predict jailbreak outcomes. Our results show that a single vanilla-state evaluation may not fully characterize jailbreak robustness, motivating evaluations that also examine how robustness changes across non-vanilla operational states.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究大语言模型在面对越狱攻击时的鲁棒性评估问题。现有评估通常只在默认配置（香草状态）下测量单一的攻击成功率（ASR），但实际用户与LLM的交互可能产生多种非默认的操作状态。作者发现，越狱鲁棒性对操作状态变化高度敏感：即使攻击方法完全不变，仅修改一个并非为影响安全而设计的普通系统提示，也能显著改变攻击成功率。研究在七个对齐模型和三种代表性越狱攻击上系统验证了这一现象，观察到香草状态与非香草状态下ASR存在巨大差异，其中一个案例仅因操作状态变化，ASR就从2%飙升至58%。值得注意的是，这些增幅甚至出现在原本针对香草状态优化设计的攻击中。进一步分析表明，状态相关的鲁棒性变化与隐藏表示中沿拒绝相关轴的方向差异存在系统性关联，且在该轴上的投影能强有力地预测越狱结果。该工作证明单一香草状态评估可能无法全面刻画越狱鲁棒性，主张评估应同时考察鲁棒性在非香草操作状态下的变化。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示现有越狱评估可能严重高估或低估模型安全性，为蓝队提供了一种更贴近真实使用场景的鲁棒性评估思路，对理解LLM安全边界和设计评估基准具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响主流LLM安全评估方法论，可能导致现有单点ASR指标被质疑，对安全红队测试、模型上线前评估和系统提示工程有直接参考意义。

items.title: Understanding Stage-Wise Utility-Risk Trade-offs in LLM Agent Memory
items.summary: Long-term memory is becoming a core capability of LLM agents, enabling personalization and long-horizon interaction. However, memory mechanisms that retain, transform, or expose more information can affect both benign utility and susceptibility to memory poisoning. Existing evaluations typically measure memory utility or attack risk in isolation under fixed configurations, providing limited insight into how stage-specific design choices reshape their trade-off. We present \textsc{MemGauge}, a controllable framework that separately varies writing admission, management policy, and retrieval exposure under matched clean and poisoned conditions. Across 11 LLMs and two long-term memory benchmarks, controlled evaluations reveal three distinct profiles: a threshold-like risk transition during writing, policy-dependent local decoupling during management, and coupled growth of utility and risk during retrieval. We further apply analogous stage-level measurements to four existing memory systems and observe diagnostic associations qualitatively consistent with these profiles. These results show that targeted poisoning risk varies across memory operations and motivate stage-aware evaluation and control of LLM-agent memory.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究 LLM Agent 长期记忆机制中良性效用与记忆投毒风险之间的阶段性权衡。作者指出，现有评测通常在固定配置下孤立地衡量记忆效用或攻击风险，难以揭示不同记忆阶段（写入、管理、检索）的设计选择如何重塑效用-风险权衡。为此，他们提出了可控评测框架 MemGauge，该框架在干净的对照条件下分别独立调节写入准入、管理策略和检索暴露三个环节，以便在相同的受控环境中比较不同记忆操作的副作用。通过对 11 个 LLM 和两个长期记忆基准进行受控评测，作者发现了三种不同的风险演化画像：写入阶段呈现类似阈值的风险突变，管理阶段呈现依赖策略的局部解耦，检索阶段则出现效用与风险的耦合增长。此外，他们将同样的阶段级测量方法应用于四个现有记忆系统，观察到的诊断关联与上述画像在定性上一致。结果表明，针对性的投毒风险在不同记忆操作之间存在差异，这为后续做阶段感知的记忆评估与控制奠定了基础。本文适合 LLM Agent 安全研究者、记忆系统设计者及需要评估长时记忆风险的安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM Agent 记忆机制是数据投毒的新攻击面，现有评估缺乏分阶段视角。本文提出可分离写入、管理、检索三阶段的评测框架，帮助蓝队定位记忆风险的存量环节，为设计更安全的 Agent 记忆系统提供实证依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何使用长期记忆的 LLM Agent 应用，如个人助理、自动化运维、客服系统，用于在部署前评估记忆模块的投毒鲁棒性。
detection_signals_zh: 记忆写入阶段的内容突发突变或高相似度注入
记忆管理阶段异常偏好或策略切换导致的留存异常
检索阶段出现与当前上下文语义不一致的记忆片段
defense_advice_zh: 对记忆写入实施准入检查与风险阈值，避免一次性大量注入
在记忆管理中引入策略隔离和异常转移检测
对检索结果进行一致性校准或敏感度过滤，降低恶意记忆被强制调用的概率

items.title: Reveree: Diagnosing LLM Reverse-Engineering Agents
items.summary: Reverse engineering (RE) is critical to security tasks such as malware analysis and vulnerability discovery, and large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly able to perform it autonomously. Capture-the-flag (CTF) RE challenges have become the standard proxy for measuring this capability, but evaluation rests on a single criterion: whether the agent captures the flag. This solve rate reveals neither where in the RE process an agent fails nor whether a success reflects analysis of the binary or recall of a public solution. In this paper, we propose Reveree, a diagnostic framework that scores an LLM RE agent's trajectory at three tiers: solve rate, milestone progress through an eight-stage RE schema, and a behavioral profile of its actions. Comprehension stages are scored by an outcome-blinded LLM judge validated against a human expert; all other stages are verified deterministically. Using Reveree, we evaluate nine frontier models and four prompting strategies on 88 picoCTF and NYU-CTF challenges. We find that the base model dominates performance, whereas prompting strategy is a secondary, model-dependent effect. Surprisingly, larger, newer, or costlier models are not reliably stronger. We also find that failures concentrate at the comprehension stages of the RE process, and that extra budget, persistence, or reasoning effort rescues few of them, pointing to a competence limit rather than a resource limit. Regarding memorization, while models reproduce picoCTF flags from challenge descriptions alone, NYU-CTF shows minimal measurable recall, and most solves survive surface perturbation, indicating that genuine analysis coexists with memorization. We release Reveree to the community.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一个名为 Reveree 的诊断框架，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在逆向工程（RE）任务中的真实能力。现有评估通常以 CTF 逆向挑战的“是否拿到 flag”作为唯一指标，但这无法揭示智能体在逆向流程中失败的具体环节，也无法区分成功是源于对二进制代码的深入分析，还是对公开答案的记忆。为此，Reveree 从三个层面评分：求解率（是否解决）、里程碑进度（将逆向流程划分为八个阶段，从二进制解析、信息收集到理解逻辑、提取 flag 等）、以及行为画像（对智能体动作的细粒度描述）。其中，理解类阶段由“不知道最终答案”的 LLM 裁判评分，该裁判已经与人类专家验证一致；其余阶段则通过确定性规则验证。作者利用 Reveree 在 88 个 picoCTF 和 NYU-CTF 挑战上评估了九个前沿模型和四种提示策略。主要发现包括：基础模型本身对性能影响最大，而提示策略的影响相对次要且依赖于模型；更大、更新或更贵的模型并不一定更强；失败主要集中在逆向流程的理解阶段，增加计算预算、延长推理或提升坚持程度对此几乎没有帮助，表明这更像能力上限而非资源限制；关于记忆问题，虽然模型能从题目描述直接复现 picoCTF 的 flag，但 NYU-CTF 上几乎没有测到记忆，且多数成功在表面扰动后仍然成立，说明真实分析与记忆共存。作者已开源 Reveree，供社区使用。该研究为 LLM 逆向能力提供了细粒度、可解释的诊断工具，对安全分析自动化评估方法有方法论贡献。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 现有 LLM 逆向评估只看是否拿 flag，掩盖了真实能力与记忆混淆的问题。Reveree 提出的八阶段得分与行为画像，让安全团队能精确了解 LLM 分析二进制时的薄弱环节，并识别训练数据记忆造成的假阳性，对可信评估智能体能力至关重要。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响 LLM 在漏洞挖掘、恶意代码分析等安全自动化场景的能力评估方法；Reveree 可作为基准工具，帮助安全工程师挑选用模型与提示策略，避免高成本模型无效投入。
