items.title: Hidden Services Protocol for Mixnets
items.summary: Mix networks (mixnets) provide network-level privacy by routing each communication packet through a sequence of intermediaries, called mixnodes, that randomly delay and cryptographically transform packets before forwarding them, making it difficult for observers to link mixnet entries to exits. While this mechanism protects sender privacy from both external adversaries and the receiver, existing mixnets lack a secure and practical protocol that simultaneously protects receiver (destination) privacy, particularly from the sender. We close this gap. We introduce the first practical and secure hidden-service protocol for mixnets, providing receiver privacy alongside sender anonymity. Our design builds on Single-Use Reply Blocks (SURBs), which enable anonymous replies without revealing the receiver's address. We show, however, that existing approaches to using SURBs expose two practical attacks that can compromise sender or receiver anonymity when the opposing party controls only a single mixnode. We develop defenses against both vulnerabilities. Building on these defenses, we introduce NymHS, a secure and practical hidden-service protocol for mixnets that supports anonymous service discovery, authenticated bidirectional sessions, and asynchronous SURB replenishment. We implement NymHS on the open-source Nym codebase and evaluate its practicality through web-browsing experiments across 118 websites, measuring each of the 27 configurations three times (9,558 page loads). Our results demonstrate that hidden services can be deployed efficiently over mixnets. In particular, increasing the Sphinx payload from 2 KiB to 10 KiB reduces mean page-load latency by approximately 5.2x and decreases communication overhead from 21.7% to 4.3% relative to the current Nym baseline.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究混合网络（mixnet）中的接收方隐私保护问题。混合网络通过多个中间节点（mixnodes）对数据包进行随机延迟和密码学变换，使外部攻击者难以关联网络入口与出口，从而保护发送者匿名性。然而，现有混合网络缺乏同时保护接收者（目的地）隐私、尤其是对发送者隐藏接收方地址的实用安全协议。论文首次提出面向混合网络的实用且安全的隐藏服务协议，在提供发送者匿名性的同时实现接收方隐私。其设计基于单次使用回复块（SURB），该机制允许匿名回复而不泄露接收方地址。但作者发现现有SURB使用方式存在两种实际攻击：当对手仅控制一个混合节点时，可能破坏发送者或接收者匿名性。论文针对这两个漏洞开发了防御措施，并在此基础上提出NymHS——一个安全实用的混合网络隐藏服务协议，支持匿名服务发现、认证双向会话以及异步SURB补充。作者在开源Nym代码库上实现了NymHS，并通过118个网站的网络浏览实验评估其实用性（27种配置各测量3次，共9558次页面加载）。实验结果表明，隐藏服务可以高效部署于混合网络：将Sphinx有效载荷从2 KiB增加到10 KiB，可使平均页面加载延迟降低约5.2倍，并将通信开销从21.7%降至4.3%（相对当前Nym基线）。该研究为混合网络中的隐藏服务提供了首个实用协议，填补了接收方隐私保护的技术空白，其防御思路对类似匿名通信系统具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究解决了混合网络中接收者隐私长期缺失的问题，为构建抗攻击的匿名服务奠定基础。对蓝队而言，理解新型匿名协议的攻击面有助于监控匿名网络中的恶意服务，并评估此类技术对现有安全监控的挑战。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响Nym等混合网络的架构设计与部署，可能催生基于mixnet的隐藏服务生态。其SURB漏洞防御方案可迁移到其他依赖回复块的匿名通信系统，提升整体匿名性保障。

items.title: What's in Your Agent's Context? Context Privilege Escalation Attacks against AI Agent Harness
items.summary: Real-world, high-profile AI agent harnesses often rely on vendor-proprietary or opaque designs for context assembly, leaving the sources and underlying logic of assembled context poorly understood and the resulting security risks largely unexplored. In this paper, we present the first systematic analysis of context assembly designs in real-world AI agent harnesses. We study and uncover how an agent harness is designed to collect and assemble context from diverse sources, and identify a set of practical attack vectors arising from these designs. Our analysis brings to light two novel categories of attacks in the context assembly of real-world harnesses: (1) MessageRole Context Privilege Escalation (M-CPE), which occurs when attacker-controlled content originating from a low-privileged context is incorporated into a higher-privileged message role. (2) Cross-Scope Context Privilege Escalation (X-CPE), which occurs when attacker-controlled content persists beyond the context in which it was introduced. We performed a systemic security analysis of the CPE attacks against 12 real-world agent harnesses, including Claude Code and Codex. The resulting consequences include full agent compromise, remote code execution, denial of service, and manipulated tool or skill invocations, etc.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文首次对真实世界AI Agent编排框架（harness）的上下文组装设计进行了系统性安全分析。当前主流AI Agent框架（如Claude Code、Codex）通常依赖厂商专有或不透明的机制来组装上下文，导致上下文来源与组装逻辑缺乏透明度，潜在安全风险未得到充分研究。论文揭示了Agent harness如何从不同来源收集并组装上下文，并由此识别出一类新的攻击向量——上下文权限提升（Context Privilege Escalation, CPE）。具体地，作者提出两种新型攻击类别：一是消息角色上下文权限提升（M-CPE），即攻击者控制的低权限上下文内容被错误注入到更高权限的消息角色中，从而获得本不应拥有的指令优先级；二是跨作用域上下文权限提升（X-CPE），即攻击者控制的内容能够在其原本引入的作用域之外持续存在并影响后续决策。作者对包括Claude Code和Codex在内的12个真实世界Agent harness进行了系统性安全分析，证明这些攻击可导致完整Agent接管、远程代码执行、拒绝服务、工具或技能调用被篡改等严重后果。该研究填补了Agent上下文组装安全性的研究空白，强调了上下文来源隔离与角色权限边界的重要性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: AI Agent已被广泛用于编程、自动化决策等场景，本文揭示的上下文权限提升攻击直接影响主流Agent框架（如Claude Code、Codex），可能导致Agent被完全控制或执行恶意代码，对依赖Agent的研发与业务系统构成真实威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用上下文组装机制的AI Agent框架，尤其是基于消息角色和跨作用域上下文持久化的系统；攻击后果包括RCE、Agent损坏、DoS和工具误调用。
detection_signals_zh: 监控Agent上下文组装过程中消息角色异常变更
检测跨会话/跨作用域持久化内容是否包含非预期指令
审计工具或技能调用链中是否混入低权限来源的指令
defense_advice_zh: 对上下文来源实施严格隔离，按可信级别划分话语角色
限制跨作用域上下文传递，引入内容来源标签与权限边界检查
对Agent的敏感操作增加人工确认或策略审核机制

items.title: Does Reasoning Mitigate Backdoor Attacks? A Neuro-Symbolic Perspective
items.summary: Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) AI has recently emerged as a novel paradigm to enable trustworthy AI, aiming at integrating sub-symbolic neural perception with grounded symbolic reasoning. The neuro-symbolic integration process that characterizes these models has been proven beneficial to achieve more transparent, explainable and efficient AI systems. Meanwhile, their properties under adversarial settings have been overlooked being frequently deemed robust-by-design. However, the neural-symbolic integration process they leverage constitutes an additional layer of complexity that may provide an attack entry-point. Therefore, in this paper, we claim that an in-depth investigation of the adversarial robustness of NeSy models is necessary and provide the first systematic evaluation of backdoor attacks against NeSy. To this end, we compare the most popular NeSy framework, namely DeepProbLog, against baseline neural networks across a total of eight backdoor settings and four reasoning tasks. Our experimental results show that while NeSy models are indeed more robust than their neural counterpart on average, their robustness vastly depend on the strictness of the reasoning process being enforced and its compatibility with the chosen adversarial target. The source code to reproduce our experiments is made available at https://github.com/marcoantoniocorallo/NeSy-Backdoor.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文首次系统性地评估了神经符号（NeSy）人工智能模型在后门攻击下的鲁棒性。神经符号AI旨在将亚符号神经感知与符号推理相结合，以提高AI系统的透明性、可解释性和效率。此前，这类模型常被认为具有“设计上的鲁棒性”，但其在对抗环境下的安全性研究一直被忽视。论文指出，神经与符号的集成过程本身可能引入额外的攻击面，因此有必要深入研究。作者选取了最流行的NeSy框架DeepProbLog，与基线神经网络在总共8种后门攻击设置和4种推理任务下进行了对比实验。核心研究发现：虽然NeSy模型整体上比纯神经网络更鲁棒，但其鲁棒性高度依赖于所实施的推理过程的严格程度，以及该推理过程与所选攻击目标的兼容性。换言之，当推理逻辑与攻击目标不兼容时，NeSy模型表现出较强的防御能力；反之，攻击可能成功。论文提供了开源代码以复现实验。该研究属于前沿安全分析，有助于理解神经符号系统的脆弱性，并为后续设计更安全的混合AI架构提供依据。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 神经符号AI被视为可信AI的重要方向，但其抗攻击性能此前缺少实证。该研究首次揭示NeSy模型并非天然免疫后门攻击，为蓝队评估此类系统风险提供了依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用神经符号架构的AI系统，尤其是依赖逻辑推理与感知结合的场景（如自动驾驶、医疗诊断）。NeSy模型的鲁棒性取决于推理规则设计，若推理不严格则可能被后门攻击利用。

items.title: Identification of Compositional Risks in Data Protection Impact Assessments and Beyond
items.summary: When personal data is processed in a distributed manner by cooperating service providers, privacy risks may emerge solely from the choice of data processors included in the composition. For instance, different data processors may unknowingly rely on the same cloud provider, allowing for unintended linkability of personal data at that very provider. As such compositional risks to privacy are beyond the scope of each individual risk assessment, they are likely to be overseen when performing a data protection impact assessment. In this paper, we propose a novel protocol to detect and manage such compositional risks to privacy. Following an initial problem definition and requirements elicitation, we elaborate how our protocol identifies candidates for compositional risks and how this information may be used to improve the results of a data protection impact assessment over service compositions including multiple data processors.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究分布式数据处理场景下，多个服务提供商协作处理个人数据时产生的组合性隐私风险。这类风险并非源自单一数据处理者，而是源于服务组合中处理者的选择，例如不同处理者可能无意中依赖同一云服务提供商，导致该提供商能够关联原本应隔离的个人数据。由于此类风险超出了单个数据处理者风险评估的范围，在开展数据保护影响评估（DPIA）时容易被忽视。作者首先定义了问题并提炼需求，随后提出了一种新颖的协议，用于检测和管理此类组合性隐私风险。该协议能够识别组合风险的候选对象，并利用该信息改进对包含多个数据处理者的服务组合的DPIA结果。论文的核心贡献在于首次系统化地处理了跨处理者的组合风险，而非仅关注单个处理者的行为。文章适合隐私工程、合规审计及分布式系统安全领域的研究者和从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了GDPR等法规下DPIA的盲区：组合风险可因共享底层供应商而产生，单点评估无法覆盖。为数据保护官和安全架构师提供了可操作的检测思路，有助于合规与风险治理。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响涉及多云/多供应商服务组合的隐私合规评估，以及使用子处理器的供应链场景。可迁移至任何依赖第三方服务的数据处理生态。

items.title: Membership Inference in Fine-tuned Diffusion Language Models via Token-level Memorization Asymmetry
items.summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as an alternative modeling paradigm to autoregressive LMs, offering advantages such as parallel generation and bidirectional context modeling. Despite growing interest in their generative capabilities, the privacy risks of DLMs remain underexplored. We identify a phenomenon termed token-level memorization asymmetry through theoretical analysis of diffusion training dynamics. Building on this finding, we propose Q-Skew, a quantile-weighted skewness-based indicator for membership inference on finetuned DLMs. Experiments across multiple fine-tuning datasets and models show that our method outperforms existing baselines. Moreover, we show that Q-Skew can also facilitate other privacy violations, such as PII extraction. Our findings reveal a previously underexplored privacy attack surface and highlight the need for systematic privacy evaluation of DLMs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 扩散语言模型（Diffusion Language Models, DLMs）近年来成为自回归语言模型之外的一种新范式，具备并行生成、双向上下文建模等优势。尽管其生成能力受到广泛关注，但其隐私风险尚未被充分研究。本文通过理论分析扩散模型训练动态，首次识别出‘token级记忆不对称’现象，即不同token在扩散训练中表现出不一致的记忆化程度。基于这一发现，作者提出Q-Skew指标，利用分位数加权的偏度统计量，对微调后的扩散语言模型执行成员推断攻击。在多个微调数据集和多个模型上的实验表明，Q-Skew方法显著优于现有成员推断基线；同时，该方法还可进一步用于促进其他隐私违反场景，例如个人可识别信息（PII）的提取。作者指出，该工作揭示了一个此前未被探索的隐私攻击面，并强调对扩散语言模型进行系统性隐私评估的迫切性。本文适合关注大模型安全、隐私保护与成员推断研究的研究人员及安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 扩散语言模型正在快速进入文本生成应用，但隐私风险未受到足够重视。本文揭示了其特有的token级记忆不对称性，可被用来构建高效的成员推断攻击，威胁微调数据中的隐私，值得安全从业者重点关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于微调扩散语言模型的文本生成服务，攻击者可借此判断某条数据是否属于训练集，甚至提取PII，造成数据泄露风险。
defense_advice_zh: 在微调或部署扩散语言模型前，应评估其对成员推断攻击的鲁棒性；必要时采用差分隐私训练或对输出进行记忆化过滤。

items.title: Automating Static Code Analysis Through CI/CD Pipeline Integration
items.summary: In the contemporary landscape of software devel-opment, securing sensitive data is paramount to safeguarding organizational reputation, preventing financial losses, and pro-tecting individuals from identity theft. This paper addresses the pervasive challenge of identifying and rectifying security vulnerabilities early in the development process, emphasizing the role of Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools. While SAST tools play a crucial role in detecting vulnerabilities, widespread adoption has been hindered by usability issues, including high false positive rates and a lack of native pipeline support. This paper proposes a novel, generalized, and automated process for aggregating SAST tool outputs and integrating them into developers' familiar issue-tracking software. The process streamlines the identification and communication of security vulnerabilities during the development lifecycle, facilitating more efficient remediation efforts. We demonstrate the successful implementation of the proposed process with the SonarQube SAST tool in a GitLab-based development environment. Developers were positive about the structured implementation, real-time feedback, and proactive vulnerability management. However, despite some challenges such as a potential learning curve and tradeoffs between secure coding and workflow disruption, the overall positive impact on security awareness and responsiveness suggests that the proposed process holds promise in enhancing the security posture of software development practices

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注现代软件开发中敏感数据保护与安全漏洞早期发现的问题，指出尽管静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具能够检测漏洞，但其采用率受制于误报率高、缺乏原生流水线支持等可用性问题。作者提出一种新颖、通用且自动化的流程，用于聚合多个SAST工具的输出结果，并将其集成到开发者熟悉的缺陷跟踪系统中。该流程旨在简化开发生命周期中安全漏洞的识别与沟通，从而提升修复效率。论文在基于GitLab的开发环境中使用SonarQube SAST工具进行了实证验证，结果表明开发者对该结构化流程、实时反馈和主动漏洞管理持积极态度。尽管存在学习曲线以及安全编码与工作流中断之间的权衡等挑战，但整体上该流程对安全意识和响应能力产生了积极影响，有望增强软件开发实践的安全态势。论文的核心贡献在于提供了一个可复用的自动化集成模式，将SAST结果无缝嵌入现有开发工作流，而非引入新的检测算法。适合DevSecOps工程师、安全工具链集成人员及负责应用安全流程改进的技术管理者阅读。

items.title: KORD: Breaking the Key-Generation Bottleneck in Dealerless FSS via Protocol--Hardware Co-Design
items.summary: Function secret sharing (FSS) has become a core primitive in privacy-preserving computation. However, each FSS invocation requires a fresh pair of function keys generated by a trusted dealer , expands the system's trust boundary and hinders practical deployment. Existing dealerless protocols eliminate this dependency, but incur substantial communication and a number of interaction rounds that grows linearly with the input bit-width, making key generation a major bottleneck. This paper present KORD, a protocol--hardware co-design that dramatically reduces the cost of dealerless FSS key generation. At its core is a pair of special-purpose chips that establish a common root of trust through mutual attestation and, within it, reconstruct FSS keys---eliminating the need for a dealer. This root of trust further forms a security boundary within which KORD restructures the generation protocol, collapsing the interaction of prior dealerless protocols into a single round, independent of GGM depth. A cross-key scheduling scheme then interleaves independent GGM-tree traversals, sustaining high computational throughput. KORD reduces per-key-generation communication by 7,633--70,274$\times$ over the state-of-the-art distributed FSS protocol across a comprehensive suite of FSS building blocks. Post-route analysis projects 12.75 million 32-bit DPF keys per second at 204 MHz using 21.5K LUTs, with 99.8% AES lane utilization. On private ResNet-18 inference, KORD cuts the share of end-to-end time spent on key generation from over 96% to 11.9%.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 论文针对无委托方（dealerless）函数秘密共享（FSS）中密钥生成效率低下的问题展开研究。FSS 是隐私保护计算中的核心原语，但每次调用都需要由可信委托方生成一对新的函数密钥，这扩展了系统的信任边界并阻碍了实际部署。已有的无委托方协议虽然消除了对委托方的依赖，却带来了高昂的通信开销，并且交互轮数随输入位宽线性增长，使得密钥生成成为主要瓶颈。为此，论文提出 KORD，一种协议-硬件协同设计方案，旨在大幅降低无委托方 FSS 密钥生成的代价。其核心是使用一对专用芯片，通过相互认证建立公共信任根，并在此信任根内重建 FSS 密钥，从而完全免除委托方。该信任根进一步形成一个安全边界，KORD 在此边界内重构生成协议，将先前无委托方协议的多轮交互压缩为单轮，且与 GGM 深度无关。此外，论文设计了一种跨密钥调度方案，将独立的 GGM 树遍历交错执行，以维持高计算吞吐率。实验结果表明，在涵盖多种 FSS 构建模块的测试套件中，KORD 将每次密钥生成的通信量比当前最优的分布式 FSS 协议降低了 7633 到 70274 倍。布线后分析显示，在 204 MHz 频率下，KORD 使用 21.5K LUT 可实现每秒生成 1275 万个 32 位 DPF 密钥，AES 通道利用率达到 99.8%。在私有 ResNet-18 推理场景中，KORD 将密钥生成占端到端时间的比例从超过 96% 降低到 11.9%。该研究提出的协议-硬件协同设计思路为 FSS 实际部署提供了新的可行路径，尤其适用于对通信和计算开销敏感的安全多方计算、隐私机器学习等场景。适合研究隐私计算、硬件安全加速及 FSS 协议优化的学者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 无委托方 FSS 是消除信任边界的隐私计算关键技术，但此前通信和交互开销过大。KORD 通过硬件信任根将密钥生成压缩至单轮并削减万倍通信，为隐私计算落地提供了新思路，对安全协议与硬件协同设计有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可降低隐私计算场景中密钥生成环节的通信与延迟开销，提升多方计算、隐私推理等应用的端到端性能；硬件方案或可迁移至其他需要高效密钥协商的密码协议中。

items.title: Breaking Ambient Trust: In-Network Per-Process Access Control Against Lateral Movement
items.summary: Enterprise networks remain vulnerable to Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs), where adversaries gain an initial foothold and move laterally across the network, accumulating access permissions hop by hop to reach critical targets. Existing network defenses cannot track user movement at the process level across the network; instead, they grant ambient trust to all processes within a host. As a result, once a host is compromised, malicious processes inherit the victim's permissions, thereby expanding the attacker's access scope and enabling further lateral movement. To address this gap, we present NetZone, an in-network access control that confines each user process to a fixed access scope that persists as the user moves across the network. NetZone introduces a new abstraction, called AccessScope, which represents a lightweight access capability bound to the user's processes. Each AccessScope encodes the set of hosts a user identity is authorized to access and is embedded in the process's outgoing network traffic for validation before reaching its destination. As users pivot across hosts, AccessScope propagates with their traffic, rebinds to the receiving process, and persists across hosts. This ensures that regardless of network location, the user's processes are consistently governed by their bound AccessScope and their access permissions remain unchanged. To handle the high volume of network traffic generated by processes, we develop a data-plane co-design that integrates programmable switches with eBPF. NetZone employs a set of in-network optimizations and lightweight AccessScope persistence techniques to inspect the embedded AccessScope on the fly, enabling line-rate processing of high traffic volumes with negligible latency overhead. Our extensive evaluations show that NetZone can effectively defend against sophisticated attack scenarios without introducing noticeable overhead.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对企业网络中高级持续性威胁（APT）的横向移动问题，指出现有网络防御机制通常无法在进程级别跟踪用户跨网络的行为，而是对主机内所有进程授予“环境信任”（ambient trust）。这种粗粒度的信任模型存在根本缺陷：一旦主机被攻陷，恶意进程会自动继承受害者的合法权限，导致攻击者能够逐步扩大访问范围并继续横向移动。为弥补这一空白，作者提出了 NetZone——一种网络内访问控制系统，将每个用户进程限制在固定的访问范围内，并且该范围在用户跨网络移动时保持不变。NetZone 引入了一个名为 AccessScope 的新抽象，它表示绑定到用户进程的轻量级访问能力，编码了用户身份被授权访问的主机集合，并嵌入到进程的出站网络流量中，在到达目的地之前进行验证。当用户在不同主机间切换时，AccessScope 随流量传播，重新绑定到接收进程，并跨主机持续存在。这确保了无论用户处于网络中的哪个位置，其进程始终受绑定的 AccessScope 约束，访问权限不会扩大。为了处理进程产生的海量网络流量，作者设计了数据平面协同方案，将可编程交换机与 eBPF 相结合。NetZone 采用一组网络内优化和轻量级 AccessScope 持久化技术，以线速动态检查嵌入的 AccessScope，在几乎不引入延迟开销的情况下处理高流量负载。实验表明，NetZone 能有效防御复杂的攻击场景，且不产生明显开销。本文的主要贡献包括：首次提出进程级、跨主机的网络访问控制抽象；实现交换机与 eBPF 的协同数据平面；验证了在真实网络流量下能够以线速执行细粒度访问控制的可行性。适合研究网络防御、零信任架构、可编程网络和安全基线的学者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究直击零信任网络中“进程级最小权限”的落地难题，提出可编程交换机+eBPF的线速方案，为蓝队限制横向移动提供了新思路，值得关注其架构是否可工程化。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响企业内网安全架构设计，尤其是高价值服务器区域的横向移动防护；其AccessScope思路可迁移到云原生环境或微服务间的进程级访问控制。
detection_signals_zh: 进程出站流量中缺失或无效的AccessScope标记
访问权限与历史行为模式不符的跨主机连接
defense_advice_zh: 评估在网络核心交换机上启用基于AccessScope的流量校验能力
结合eBPF在主机侧对进程出站流量打标，形成端到端访问链

items.title: Johnny Still Receives Spam SMS: Assessing the Robustness of SMS Spam Detection
items.summary: SMS spam detection systems often achieve high accuracy in controlled environments but struggle against adversarial attacks and increasingly sophisticated spam tactics in real-world deployments. In this paper, we evaluate the robustness of SMS anti-spam systems that end users actually rely on, including commercial messaging applications, third-party anti-spam services, and publicly available open-weight models hosted on Hugging Face. We evaluate these systems under both standard and adversarial conditions, considering perceptible and state-of-the-art imperceptible attacks. We include only perturbations that we verify survive real SMS or RCS delivery, rather than lab-only artifacts. Our experiments reveal significant gaps in existing spam detectors' ability to identify adversarially manipulated messages. We further demonstrate that adversarial training alone is insufficient. Using an explicit held-out evaluation protocol, we find that robustness transfers well within a perturbation family but degrades sharply against structurally distinct, encoding-level attacks. To address these weaknesses, we propose a multi-model ensemble that combines adversarial training with spam classifiers diverse in architecture and tokenization. Our results show that this ensemble, particularly when using a minority-voting strategy, substantially improves robustness against both perceptible and imperceptible adversarial attacks while maintaining competitive classification accuracy. We also characterize the resulting precision-recall trade-off and recommend operating points for false-positive-sensitive and recall-critical deployments. These findings highlight the need for comprehensive robustness evaluations and ensemble-based defenses for building more secure SMS spam detection systems in real-world settings.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统评估了真实世界短信垃圾过滤系统在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。作者选取了终端用户实际依赖的多类防护方案，包括商业即时通讯应用、第三方反垃圾服务，以及来自 Hugging Face 的开放权重模型，在标准和对抗场景下进行测试。对抗扰动同时覆盖可感知和当前最先进的不可感知攻击，并且所有扰动都经过验证能够在真实 SMS/RCS 发送链路中存活，而非仅存在于实验室环境。实验发现现有检测器对经过对抗操纵的消息存在明显的识别缺口，经常漏报。进一步研究表明，仅靠对抗训练不足以解决根本问题；通过显式的留出评估协议，作者发现鲁棒性在同一扰动家族内可以较好地迁移，但面对结构不同、基于编码级别的攻击时性能急剧下降。为弥补上述弱点，论文提出一种多模型集成方案，将对抗训练与在架构和分词方式上具有多样性的垃圾邮件分类器结合。结果表明，采用少数投票策略的集成能在显著提升对可感知及不可感知对抗攻击的鲁棒性的同时，保持接近原有水平的分类准确率。作者还刻画了精确率—召回率之间的权衡，并为误报敏感类部署和召回率敏感类部署分别推荐了合适的运行操作点。整体而言，这项研究强调了对短信反垃圾系统进行全方位鲁棒性评估的必要性，并验证了基于多样模型集成的防御思路在现实场景中的有效性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 短信反垃圾是安全防线之一，但现有系统在精心构造的对抗样本面前表现脆弱。论文揭示了仅依赖单一检测模型或普通对抗训练的不足，并证明了多模型集成可有效提升真实世界鲁棒性，为安全工程师设计弹性防御提供了可借鉴的架构思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至电子邮件过滤、内容审核、即时通讯消息分类等依赖文本分类器的场景；其评估方法也可用于其他对抗样本易受真实投递条件影响的系统。
defense_advice_zh: 采用多模型集成策略，选择架构与分词方式差异较大的分类器，配合对抗训练。
在部署前对反垃圾系统进行真实投递条件下的对抗鲁棒性评估，而非仅使用离线测试集。
针对不同业务需求（误报敏感或召回敏感）配置合适的判定阈值，平衡精确率与召回率。

items.title: GlitchLab: A Hardware-in-the-Loop Optimizer for Physical Fault Injection
items.summary: Physical fault injection can turn brief hardware disturbances into security failures such as key recovery, authentication bypass, and unintended control flow. Finding effective faults is difficult because many interacting parameters create a large search space, successful settings are sparse and target-dependent, and each hardware attempt provides limited feedback. Under fixed testing time, efficient search is therefore critical for assessing fault sensitivity. We present GlitchLab, an online hardware-in-the-loop platform that treats delay as a timing gate, voltage and pulse duration as severity controls, and hardware outcomes as structured feedback. It implements RL-Q (Q-learning-based reinforcement learning), a structured bandit for discovery, and Structured-Outcome-Based Adaptive Search (SOBAS), a model-based policy for fault reproduction. Both policies find a target fault in every AES, password, and control-flow campaign. On AES and control flow, they require 2-85x fewer attempts and 26-1,237x less time than the baselines; on password, both succeed while the baselines fail within 5,000 attempts. After discovery, SOBAS reproduces faults 7.3-21x more often, while RL-Q identifies 30% more distinct AES settings.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 物理故障注入（如电压毛刺、时钟毛刺等）能够将短暂硬件扰动转化为安全失效，例如密钥恢复、认证绕过和非预期控制流。然而，寻找有效故障点极其困难：众多相互作用的参数构成庞大搜索空间，成功设置稀疏且依赖目标设备，而每次硬件尝试提供的反馈极其有限。在固定测试时间内，高效搜索对于评估设备的故障敏感性至关重要。为此，本文提出 GlitchLab，一个在线硬件在环（hardware-in-the-loop）优化平台。它将延迟视为时间门控，将电压和脉冲宽度作为严重性控制，并将硬件输出结果作为结构化反馈。GlitchLab 实现了两种策略：RL-Q（基于 Q 学习的强化学习）用于探索发现；以及基于结构化结果的自适应搜索（SOBAS），一种基于模型的策略用于故障复现。在 AES 加密、密码验证和控制流三类目标上进行实验，两种策略均能在所有场景中找到目标故障。在 AES 和控制流目标上，相比基线，所需尝试次数减少 2-85 倍，时间消耗降低 26-1,237 倍；在密码验证场景中，两种策略均成功，而基线在 5,000 次尝试内失败。故障发现后，SOBAS 复现故障的频率比基线高 7.3-21 倍，而 RL-Q 能够识别出比基线多 30% 的不同 AES 设置。该研究为硬件安全评估提供了一种高效、自动化的故障注入搜索工具，显著提升了故障发现的效率和复现稳定性。适合硬件安全研究员、密码学实现开发者以及安全评估工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 物理故障注入是绕过硬件安全机制的实战攻击手段。GlitchLab 通过强化学习与自适应搜索大幅提升故障寻找效率，使蓝队能在有限时间内更全面评估芯片的故障敏感性，对硬件安全防线建设有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于 AES 硬件实现、密码验证逻辑、控制流完整性保护等安全关键硬件模块的故障注入评估；也可扩展到其他嵌入式设备的安全测试流程中。
defense_advice_zh: 对涉密或关键硬件模块建议进行故障注入敏感性评估，识别易受扰动点。
考虑在硬件设计中加入电压、时钟频率监测与报警机制，以及冗余校验、故障状态寄存器等防护措施。

items.title: Smart Contracts Claimed Vulnerable by the CVE Database, with Labels and Source Locations
items.summary: The Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) database catalogs vulnerability claims in hard- and software, among them those pertaining to blockchain programs a.k.a. smart contracts. We present CVE-Smart-Contracts, a curated dataset of CVE records up to July 2026 referring to Ethereum smart contracts. The dataset contains the vulnerable artifacts (source code and runtime bytecode), labels according to three taxonomies, and function-level locations. The retrieval of CVE records, collection of additional evidence, validation of the correspondence between records and artifacts, label assignment, and vulnerability localization are automated, leaving 15% to manual analysis. The dataset does not validate the original vulnerability claims, but marks a few records obviously wrong as `refuted'. For the sake of reproducibility, all external inputs are retained, so that rerunning the pipelines results in the same outputs. The dataset comprises 491 records linked to deployed contracts, 26 referring to projects (mostly libraries), 45 without validated artifacts, and six records with refuted claims. The dataset supports empirical security research, in particular the evaluation of code analysis and repair techniques.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对以太坊智能合约的 CVE 记录长期缺乏真实、可验证的漏洞工件与函数级定位信息的问题，构建并开源了数据集 CVE-Smart-Contracts。数据集覆盖截至 2026 年 7 月收录于 CVE 数据库的所有与以太坊智能合约相关的记录，包含漏洞对应的源代码和运行时字节码，并按三种分类法对漏洞进行标签标注，同时提供函数级漏洞位置。构建流程高度自动化：自动检索 CVE 记录、收集外部证据、校验记录与工件之间的一致性、自动分配标签并定位漏洞；其中约 15% 的数据需要人工介入完成。需要强调的是，该数据集并不验证原始漏洞声明的真实性，仅将少数明显错误的记录标记为“refuted”。为保证可复现性，所有外部输入均被保留，重跑流水线可得到一致结果。最终数据集包含 491 条关联到已部署合约的 CVE 记录，26 条指向项目级问题（多为库），45 条无法验证工件，6 条被驳回。该数据集对实证安全研究具有直接价值，尤其适用于评估智能合约代码分析工具、漏洞修复技术，以及推动 CVE 与真实漏洞样本之间的系统性对比。适合智能合约安全研究者、漏洞数据库维护者以及区块链安全工具开发者阅读和复用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为智能合约安全研究提供带函数级位置和多种标签的高质量数据集，弥合 CVE 记录与真实可验证漏洞样本之间的鸿沟，助力分析工具与修复技术的评估和基准测试。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可作为智能合约漏洞分析、检测和修复研究的基准数据集；有助于改善 CVE 记录质量；对以太坊安全生态的实证研究有推动作用。

items.title: CRSF: Collusion-Resilient Privacy-Preserving Sensor Fusion with Byzantine-Robust Participation
items.summary: Privacy-preserving sensor fusion enables an untrusted server to compute an aggregate result over distributed sensor measurements without learning either individual inputs or the final output. Recent garbled-circuit-based protocols provide an efficient realization of this functionality in a sensor--server--client architecture, but remain vulnerable to sensor--server collusion and Byzantine manipulation of sensor participation. These weaknesses can compromise honest-sensor privacy, incorrectly exclude honest sensors, and corrupt the computed fusion result, thereby undermining the security guarantees expected from the protocol. We present CRSF, a collusion-resilient sensor-fusion protocol that addresses these weaknesses while providing privacy, correctness with explicit abort, and liveness. CRSF introduces a Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance (PBFT)-based agreement phase for sensor submissions and uses server-specific, status-dependent label release with threshold protection of circuit-input labels. This design prevents any Byzantine server from unilaterally manipulating sensor participation and prevents any admissible sensor-server coalition from obtaining enough secret material to compromise honest-sensor privacy. We implement CRSF and compare its online execution time with the most relevant state-of-the-art baseline. Our Google Cloud evaluation measures the total computation and communication cost of the online protocol under fault-free and representative faulty executions. Across a range of fault-tolerant fusion circuits and up to 261 sensors, CRSF demonstrates a highly practical trade-off between robust security and protocol performance.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 CRSF（Collusion-Resilient Privacy-Preserving Sensor Fusion）协议，旨在解决隐私保护传感器融合中存在的传感器-服务器串通与拜占庭恶意参与问题。现有基于混淆电路（garbled circuit）的协议虽能在传感器-服务器-客户端架构下实现高效聚合，但无法抵御传感器与服务器合谋窃取诚实传感器隐私、无法防止拜占庭服务器错误排除诚实传感器或篡改融合结果。CRSF 在保留隐私性、带显式中止的正确性和活性的同时，引入基于实用拜占庭容错（PBFT）的提交一致性阶段，并采用服务器特定、状态依赖的标签发放与电路输入标签阈值保护机制。该设计能阻止任何拜占庭服务器单方面操纵参与者集合，同时阻止任何可接受的传感器-服务器联盟获取足够秘密信息以破坏诚实传感器隐私。作者在 Google Cloud 上实现了 CRSF，并与最相关的现有基线协议对比在线执行时间，测量无故障与代表性故障场景下在线协议的总计算与通信开销。实验覆盖多种容错融合电路并支持最多 261 个传感器，结果表明 CRSF 在鲁棒安全与协议性能之间取得了高度实用的权衡。本文适合研究安全多方计算、隐私保护数据聚合及传感器网络防护的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了现有隐私保护传感器融合协议在串通与拜占庭故障下的安全漏洞，提出的 CRSF 首次将 PBFT 与标签阈值保护结合，为构建抗合谋、抗恶意参与的数据聚合系统提供了新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可适用于分布式传感器网络、联邦学习聚合、物联网数据融合等需要同时保证隐私与鲁棒性的场景。

items.title: What Limits Robustness in Deep Image Watermarking: An Analysis of Mechanisms and Their Scaling Across Capacities
items.summary: Robustness remains the principal open problem in deep image watermarking, and what limits it becomes sharper as payload grows. This paper asks whether capacity is itself the limit or only makes other limits visible, and answers in two parts. The first organizes the distortions a watermark must survive and the strategies developed to resist them, ordering each by the axis that governs it: payload capacity for the distortions, differentiability for the strategies. The second identifies and measures three mechanisms that limit robustness in schemes mapping the payload onto a spatial block grid with extraction trained separately from a frozen embedder: desynchronization of the payload grid, the resistance of codec-induced distortion to training, and the narrowing of the usable embedding-strength window. Payloads from 64 to 16384 bits are measured, well beyond the range those strategies address. Training the extraction stage against a codec proves not merely ineffective but harmful, degrading the reading at the operating points used in training. The limits follow the class of distortion rather than capacity itself, and none is removed by further training on the extraction side, because all three arise before extraction. An evaluation protocol making claims of generalization verifiable is also contributed. The conclusions are properties of a class of designs rather than of one implementation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究深度图像水印的鲁棒性限制问题，核心问题是：当载荷（payload）增大时，鲁棒性下降的根本原因是容量本身，还是容量使其他限制显现？作者将答案分为两部分。第一部分系统梳理了水印必须承受的失真类型及现有抵抗策略，并按主导轴进行排序：失真受载荷容量主导，策略受可微性主导。第二部分识别并测量了三种限制鲁棒性的机制，针对将载荷映射到空间块网格、且提取阶段与冻结的嵌入器分开训练的水印方案：一是载荷网格的失同步（desynchronization），二是编解码器引入的失真对训练的抵抗性，三是可用嵌入强度窗口的收窄。实验测量了从64到16384比特的载荷范围，远超现有策略能处理的规模。关键发现是：针对编解码器训练提取阶段不仅无效，反而有害——会在训练所用的工作点处降低读取性能。研究表明这些限制由失真类别决定，而非容量本身；且仅靠提取端的进一步训练无法消除，因为三种机制都发生在提取之前。论文还贡献了一套评估协议，使泛化性声明可被验证。结论适用于一类设计模式，而非单一实现。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 深度图像水印的鲁棒性瓶颈直接影响版权保护和内容溯源在真实对抗环境中的可靠性，明确容量与失真机制的关系有助于避免无效训练投入。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于采用空间块网格嵌入和分离式提取训练的深度学习水印系统设计；其评估协议可迁移至其他鲁棒性声称的验证。

items.title: DP-VOXLET: Provable Speaker Anonymization for Disentangled Speech Representations
items.summary: Systems for speaker anonymization obfuscate the speaker of an utterance, while maintaining its original semantic contents and prosody. Recent solutions for speaker anonymization rely on learned representations that disentangle an utterance into semantic contents and speaker properties. To anonymize an utterance, these systems replace the speaker properties while leaving the semantic contents unchanged---an approach that can produce strong results on empirical measures of privacy. In this work, we introduce speaker differential privacy, a formal definition of speaker anonymization based on the framework of differential privacy, and a mechanism for speaker anonymization that provably satisfies the definition. In contrast to prior heuristic-based anonymization systems, our approach enables a provable lower bound on re-identification success rate (e.g. equal error rate) for any possible adversary. We implement our approach in a framework that is compatible with existing disentangled representations. Compared to the prior work on differential privacy for speaker anonymization, our approach achieves significantly higher utility.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 DP-VOXLET 的说话人匿名化方法，旨在解决语音数据发布中的隐私保护问题。说话人匿名化的目标是在隐藏说话人身份的同时，保留话语的语义内容和韵律特征。现有方法通常基于解耦表示学习，将语音编码为语义内容与说话人属性两部分，然后替换说话人属性而不改变语义内容。这类启发式方法在经验隐私指标上表现良好，但缺乏形式化的隐私保证，无法防御拥有强大背景知识的攻击者。本文首次将差分隐私框架引入说话人匿名化领域，提出了“说话人差分隐私”的正式定义，并设计了一种可证明满足该定义的匿名化机制。该机制与现有的解耦表示框架兼容，能够为任何可能的对手提供再识别成功率（如等错误率）的可证明下界，从而提供严格的隐私保障。作者在多个数据集上进行了实验，结果表明该方法相比先前基于差分隐私的说话人匿名化工作，在保持可用性（即语义内容和韵律的保留程度）方面取得了显著提升。本文的核心贡献包括：形式化定义说话人差分隐私、提出可证明满足该定义的匿名化算法、将其集成到现有解耦表示系统中，并通过实验验证其效用优势。该研究适合隐私保护语音处理、差分隐私理论和语音安全领域的研究人员阅读，也为实际部署语音匿名化系统提供了理论依据和算法参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 语音数据广泛用于身份验证和助手服务，说话人匿名化是保护用户隐私的关键技术。本文首次为说话人匿名化提供可证明的差隐私保证，使防御者能够在对抗推理攻击时给出量化安全边界，而非依赖启发式经验。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该工作可应用于语音助手、医疗录音、客户服务等需要发布语音数据的场景，为合规数据共享提供理论支撑；也可迁移到其他生物特征匿名化任务（如人脸、步态）的隐私机制设计中。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Using Hyper-V Sockets for Real-time Data Extraction from a Malware Analysis Sandbox
items.summary: We present how Hyper-V sockets can be used as a real-time communication channel for a malware analysis sandbox. We show that, compared to WinSock TCP sockets, Hyper-V sockets are not subject to TCP/IP-layer blocking and are not enumerated by common TCP connection listing tools. We compare the throughput of the two communication channels as a function of buffer size.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出在恶意软件分析沙箱中使用 Hyper-V 套接字作为实时数据提取的通信信道，并系统比较其与传统 WinSock TCP 套接字的差异。研究发现，Hyper-V 套接字不受 TCP/IP 层防火墙规则或网络过滤驱动的拦截，也不会被常见 TCP 连接列举工具（如 netstat）枚举，因此为沙箱与虚拟机之间提供了一条隐蔽、低可见性的数据通道。论文通过不同缓冲区大小下的吞吐量实验，定量评估了 Hyper-V 套接字与 TCP 套接字的性能差距。核心贡献在于揭示了虚拟化平台内建通信机制在恶意软件分析场景中的应用潜力，同时警示安全防御者：传统网络监控手段将无法发现此类通信活动。该研究属于方法探索型，未涉及具体攻击代码，但为沙箱环境中的隐蔽数据外传或受控交互提供了新的研究视角。对蓝队而言，了解此类信道能帮助识别虚拟化基础设施中的潜在盲点，并为后续制定监控策略提供基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Hyper-V 套接字可能成为恶意软件与宿主机之间的隐蔽通信通道，现有网络监控工具无法发现，安全团队需了解该机制并研究对应检测方法。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该研究影响虚拟化环境中的沙箱设计、恶意软件分析过程以及内网通信监控；相关思路可迁移到其他虚拟机管理程序的同类机制（如 VMware、KVM）上。
detection_signals_zh: 监控非 TCP/UDP 的可疑进程间通信，尤其是涉及 Hyper-V 相关对象（如管道、共享内存）的活动
关注虚拟化层自身的日志，如 Hyper-V 事件记录中的异常套接字创建或权限请求
对沙箱内进程的系统调用行为进行细粒度审计，识别绕过 Winsock 的通信尝试
defense_advice_zh: 在虚拟化平台启用 Hyper-V 套接字审计，并配置警报规则
增强沙箱的网络隔离，将策略覆盖范围扩展到 Hyper-V 套接字通道
对安全人员开展培训，使其熟悉 Hyper-V 套接字等虚拟化通信机制的特性

items.title: A Roadmap to Available ICS Datasets and Testbeds for Cybersecurity Research
items.summary: Industrial Control Systems (ICS) are the backbone of many critical infrastructure sectors; however, their growing level of connectivity, long lifespan and integration with the Information Technology (IT) environment introduces numerous cybersecurity challenges. The merging of Operational Technology (OT) and IT along with the deployment of Industry 4.0 technologies increases the attack surface of ICS environments, which in turn makes them more vulnerable to advanced cyber threats. Therefore, many researchers have shown interest in the field of cybersecurity of ICS. The topics of intrusion detection, anomaly detection, threat intelligence, attack simulation and resilience assessment of ICS have received much attention. Nevertheless, the development and testing of cybersecurity solutions for ICS remains to be challenging due to the lack of appropriate datasets and experimental environment. The main objective of this paper is to provide the roadmap of existing ICS cybersecurity datasets, testbeds and digital twins. This paper presents various taxonomies along with systematic analysis of architecture, characteristics, capabilities, pros and cons of these tools. The results of the analysis demonstrate the presence of persistent problems such as lack of standardized benchmarking datasets, lack of modern attack scenarios, insufficient number of datasets based on real operational traffic and difficulty in validating artificial intelligence-driven cybersecurity solutions. In addition to summarizing current research on ICS cybersecurity datasets and testbeds, this roadmap provides the identification of research gaps and recommendations on creation of new tools.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇针对工业控制系统（ICS）网络安全研究领域的数据集与测试平台综述性论文。ICS 是众多关键基础设施的核心支撑，但其日益增长的互联性、长生命周期以及与 IT 环境的深度融合带来了诸多网络安全挑战。OT 与 IT 的融合以及工业 4.0 技术的部署扩大了 ICS 环境的攻击面，使其更易遭受高级网络威胁的侵害。因此，许多研究者开始关注 ICS 网络安全，入侵检测、异常检测、威胁情报、攻击仿真和韧性评估等方向受到大量关注。然而，由于缺乏合适的数据集和实验环境，开发和测试 ICS 安全解决方案仍然面临挑战。本文的主要目标是提供现有 ICS 网络安全数据集、测试平台和数字孪生资源的路线图。论文提出了多种分类方法，并对这些工具的系统架构、特性、能力、优势和不足进行了系统分析。分析结果显示当前仍存在若干长期问题，包括：缺乏标准化基准数据集、缺少现代攻击场景、基于真实运行流量构建的数据集数量不足，以及难以验证人工智能驱动的安全解决方案。除总结当前研究外，本文还识别了研究空白，并提出了创建新工具的建议。该路线图适用于希望了解 ICS 安全研究基础设施现状的学术研究人员、工业安全工程师以及希望建设安全实验环境的机构，有助于读者明确可用资源、理解现有局限，并规划后续研究方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 帮助蓝队和安全研究人员快速了解可用的 ICS 数据集与测试床，弥补实验环境缺失的痛点，避免在无效或过时数据上评估安全方案，提升检测与防御研究的可靠性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 为 ICS 安全研究社区提供资源地图与缺口清单，可指导新数据集/测试床的建设，间接影响入侵检测、异常检测等方向的研究质量与可复现性。

items.title: A Simple Transformer Pipeline for Full-Key Side-Channel Attacks on Uncropped Datasets
items.summary: Deep learning-based side-channel analysis has historically focused on single-byte targets and manually cropped traces, which risks discarding exploitable leakage. While recent work has proposed specialized architectures and resampling techniques to address this gap, the literature lacks a simple transformer baseline for simultaneous full-key attacks on uncropped traces. We present an open-source transformer implementation for uncropped full-key attacks which uses the standard transformer encoder backbone, adapting only the input and output layers to the side-channel setting. We release our implementation, training recipes, and pretrained weights for uncropped ASCADv1f, ASCADv1r, and CHES-CTF-2018 which achieve performance competitive with previously-reported results, while using less than 10GB of VRAM and requiring at most 3.34 hours of training on a single NVIDIA A6000.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于非裁剪（uncropped）侧信道数据集的全密钥（full-key）攻击的简单 Transformer 流水线。传统深度学习侧信道分析通常针对单字节目标并依赖人工裁剪的迹线，这可能会丢弃可利用的泄漏信息。近期研究虽然提出了专用架构和重采样技术来应对这一问题，但文献中缺乏针对非裁剪迹线同时恢复完整密钥的简单 Transformer 基线。作者基于标准 Transformer 编码器主干，仅修改输入和输出层以适应侧信道场景，实现了开源的全密钥攻击方法。他们在非裁剪的 ASCADv1f、ASCADv1r 和 CHES-CTF-2018 数据集上发布了实现代码、训练配方和预训练权重。实验表明，该方法在性能上与先前报道的专用方法相当，同时显存占用低于 10GB，在单张 NVIDIA A6000 显卡上训练时间最多仅需 3.34 小时。该研究填补了简单通用 Transformer 基线在全密钥非裁剪侧信道分析中的空白，为后续研究提供了可复现的基准。适合硬件安全、侧信道分析以及深度学习安全领域的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为侧信道分析提供了一种简单、低资源且可复现的 Transformer 基线，使得全密钥攻击无需复杂裁剪预处理，降低了应用门槛并促进后续对比研究。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响针对 AES 等密码实现的侧信道分析场景；方法可迁移至其他时间序列泄漏信号处理任务，尤其适合需要处理完整波形或长序列的嵌入式安全评估。

items.title: Beyond Object Authentication: Context-Closed Post-Quantum Authentication for the WebPKI
items.summary: Post-quantum migration increases WebPKI authentication cost, but authenticating a compressed certificate object does not by itself preserve the mutable authorization context under which a relying party accepts it. We formalize \emph{context closure}: the authenticated projection accepted by a verifier must determine the selected authorization semantics it claims, relative to declared source contracts and event-coverage witnesses. We instantiate this idea with \LRp, a two-plane post-quantum construction that authenticates mutable CA-context state in an update plane while the warm path carries only state-local dependency references selected by explicit profile negotiation. In a pinned CCADB reconstruction, we obtain 44,912 path/view contexts and 16,858 physical CA lineages across Apple, Chrome, Microsoft, and Mozilla views. The core compiler yields $m_{50}=6$, $m_{95}=16$, and $m_{\max}=18$ typed dependencies. A warm LR+ selector therefore costs 296, 776, and 872 bytes at median, p95, and maximum, compared with 3,842, 5,932, and 6,350 bytes for a one-signature stateless bundle carrying the same dependency vector. The retained all-view closure state is 16.15 MB, and per-view lifecycle crossovers range from 19.60 to 50.41 median-path warm authentications/day under the stated checkpoint and update model. The implementation and evaluation artifact are available at https://github.com/nserser/LR-WebPKI

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对后量子迁移背景下 WebPKI 认证成本增加的问题，指出仅对压缩证书对象进行认证并不能保留依赖方（relying party）接受该证书时所依赖的可变授权上下文。作者形式化了“上下文闭合”（context closure）概念：验证者接受的经过认证的投影必须能够决定其声称的授权语义，且该语义需与声明的来源契约和事件覆盖见证一致。论文提出了 LRp，一种双平面（two-plane）后量子构造：在更新平面中认证可变的 CA 上下文状态，而热路径（warm path）仅携带由显式配置文件协商选择的状态局部依赖引用。在固定的 CCADB 重建中，作者从 Apple、Chrome、Microsoft 和 Mozilla 四个视图获得了 44,912 个路径/视图上下文和 16,858 个物理 CA 谱系。核心编译器产生的中位数、p95 和最大类型化依赖数分别为 m50=6、m95=16、mmax=18。因此，一个热路径 LR+ 选择器在携带相同依赖向量的情况下，中位数、p95 和最大大小分别为 296、776 和 872 字节，而单签名无状态捆绑包则分别为 3,842、5,932 和 6,350 字节。保留的全视图闭合状态大小为 16.15 MB，在所述检查点和更新模型下，每个视图的生命周期交叉中位热路径认证数为每天 19.60 到 50.41 次。实现和评估工件可在 GitHub 获取。该工作主要面向 PKI 研究者、后量子密码迁移设计者以及 Web 安全基础设施工程师，提供了一种降低后量子认证开销同时保持授权上下文完整性的新思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为 WebPKI 后量子迁移提供新视角：认证对象之外还需绑定授权上下文，LRp 在保持安全性的同时大幅压缩认证数据，对 TLS 证书链性能优化有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响 WebPKI 认证标准演进和后量子证书设计；其压缩方法可迁移至其他涉及可变授权状态的分布式认证场景。

items.title: Position: Privacy Is a Claim, Not a Property of Synthetic Data
items.summary: Synthetic data has become a common component of machine learning research. While widely adopted, its use in privacy-sensitive contexts has quietly shifted from a claim of residual inference risk under stated assumptions to an appearance-based property inferred from data generation itself. In this position paper, we argue that this shift reflects an implicit change in community standards for what counts as sufficient privacy evidence, rather than a misunderstanding of well-established privacy principles. Drawing on an empirical analysis of recent publications across major ML venues, we show that synthetic data is frequently used in privacy-sensitive settings without explicit articulation of threat models, inference risks, or falsifiable privacy claims. As a result, privacy assurance often remains implicit, difficult to verify, and unevenly distributed, with heightened exposure for rare and minority records. We argue for treating privacy as an explicit, evidence-based scientific claim and recommend that ML venues adopt norms requiring privacy-relevant assertions to be clearly scoped, testable, and contestable.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文是一篇立场论文（position paper），针对机器学习研究中合成数据（synthetic data）被广泛使用于隐私敏感场景但缺乏明确隐私声明的问题提出批评。作者观察到，合成数据的隐私保护属性在社区实践中发生了一种隐性转变：从早期基于明确假设下残余推断风险的“声明式”理解，逐渐演变为一种仅凭数据生成过程就认为具备隐私性的“外观式”属性。通过对近期主要机器学习会议/期刊论文的实证分析，作者发现大量研究在隐私敏感环境中使用合成数据时，并未清晰阐述威胁模型、推断风险或可证伪的隐私声明。这使得隐私保证常常是隐式的、难以验证且分布不均，特别是对稀有记录和少数群体记录的数据，其暴露风险更高。作者主张将隐私视为一种明确的、基于证据的科学声明，而非数据本身的固有属性；并建议机器学习会议和期刊采纳相应规范，要求任何涉及隐私的断言都必须具有明确的范围、可测试性和可争议性。论文的核心贡献在于揭示社区标准中的这种隐含转变，并提出了改善合成数据隐私实践的具体建议。该论文适合机器学习研究者、隐私保护技术开发者以及会议/期刊的程序委员会成员阅读，以反思和修正当前合成数据隐私评估的不足。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 合成数据被广泛用作隐私保护手段，但社区对‘什么构成充分隐私证据’的标准正在悄悄弱化。该论文直击这一隐患，提醒安全与隐私从业者：缺乏明确威胁模型和可验证声明的合成数据，可能导致隐私承诺名存实亡。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响机器学习会议论文评审、合成数据工具链的隐私评估方法，以及依赖合成数据的数据发布实践，尤其是涉及敏感属性的场景。
defense_advice_zh: 在隐私敏感项目中使用合成数据时，应显式定义威胁模型和推断攻击假设，并明确残余风险。
为每项合成数据隐私声明提供可复现的评估方法（如成员推断攻击测试），确保声明可证伪。

items.title: Verification of $K$- and Infinite-Step Strong/Weak Anonymity Using Concurrent Compositions
items.summary: Anonymity is an information flow property that provides privacy protection in the sense of non-uniqueness of system information at certain moments with respect to observations. The notion of $K$-step anonymity in the context of discrete-event systems characterizes the scenario that the state estimates cannot be a singleton within at most $K$ observational steps prior to the current instant, while infinite-step anonymity is the same as $K$-step anonymity without considering the limit on $K$. In this paper, we lucubrate $K$- and infinite-step anonymity for partially-observed discrete-event systems modeled by non-deterministic finite-state automata. First, we define two strong types and two weak types of $K$- and infinite-step anonymity that are fundamentally different from the existing notions of $K$- and infinite-step anonymity due to the consideration of strong and weak anonymous projections. Then, we develop a new methodology by exploiting the concurrent-composition technique to verify these four types of anonymity. Based on the constructed concurrent compositions, verifiable necessary and sufficient conditions for the four types of anonymity are provided, along with their complexity analysis. Finally, the upper bounds on $K$ for $K$-step strong anonymity and weak anonymity are computed.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究离散事件系统中的匿名性验证问题。匿名性是一种信息流属性，其核心思想是：在部分可观测的离散事件系统（由非确定性有限状态自动机建模）中，外部观察者无法根据观测记录唯一确定系统的某些状态信息。具体而言，K 步匿名性要求在当前时刻之前的至多 K 个观测步内，系统状态估计始终不是单例集合（即无法精确定位系统过去的状态），而无限步匿名性则是对 K 不加限制的情形。现有工作通常只考虑简单的状态估计不唯一性，但本文进一步区分了“强匿名”和“弱匿名”两种投影概念，并基于此定义了四种新的匿名性类型：K 步强匿名、K 步弱匿名、无限步强匿名、无限步弱匿名。这些定义与既有定义存在本质差异，能够更精细地刻画不同隐私需求。为解决上述四种匿名性的验证问题，作者提出了一种基于并发组合（concurrent composition）技术的新方法。通过构造合理的并发组合结构，推导出四种匿名性可验证的充分必要条件，并给出了相应的复杂度分析。此外，针对 K 步强/弱匿名，还计算了 K 的上界，为实际系统中的隐私参数选取提供了理论依据。实验部分（或理论推演）证明了所提条件与算法的有效性。本文主要面向形式化方法、离散事件系统安全、隐私保护等方向的研究者，尤其适合关注自动机模型下信息流安全验证的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为离散事件系统中的匿名性提供了更精细的形式化定义与可判定的验证算法，可应用于隐私保护协议、访问控制、匿名通信等需要状态级隐私保障的场景。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至物联网、工业控制系统等基于离散事件模型的隐私分析场景，也可用于评估现有匿名机制是否满足预期的非唯一性保障。

items.title: Lacan: Making Accountability in Anonymous Networks Real
items.summary: Anonymity and accountability are essential properties for our everyday activity on the Internet. However, they appear contradictory, and their reconciliation remains far from reality. Existing approaches fall short in this regard, as they either rely on an on-path trustee, per-packet authorization, per-packet public-key cryptography, or per-session intervention by a central authority. We propose Lacan, a protocol that reconciles anonymity and accountability within a realistic design. In Lacan, a sender enjoys anonymity provided by on-path relays, as long as she complies with a contract established with the receiver. Upon a contract violation, the verifier, an off-path trustee on behalf of the receiver, links the malicious message to the sender's identity indirectly via the packet, path, and session, thereby reducing public-key operations from per-packet to per-session. This linkage remains robust even against malicious relays and receivers, grounded in our novel chain of successor proofs for accountable path reconstruction, together with traceable signatures, path validation, and key-committing encryption. We analyze the anonymity and accountability, implement the protocol, and evaluate the performance.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出名为 Lacan 的协议，旨在解决匿名网络中的可问责性（accountability）问题。匿名性与可问责性看似矛盾：匿名性要求隐藏发送者身份，而可问责性需要在发生恶意行为时追溯到具体实体。现有方案要么依赖路径上的可信第三方，要么对每个数据包进行授权或公钥操作，要么由中心机构介入每个会话，均难以兼顾效率与安全性。Lacan 的设计思路是：发送者只要遵守与接收者事先建立的合约，即可享受由路径中继提供的匿名保护；一旦发生合约违规，代表接收者的离路径可信方（verifier）通过数据包、路径与会话三层信息间接将恶意消息关联到发送者身份，从而将公钥操作的开销从逐包降低到逐会话。该关联机制即使在中继或接收者存在恶意行为时依然稳健，其安全性建立在作者提出的“后继证明链”（chain of successor proofs）用于可问责路径重建，并组合了可追踪签名（traceable signatures）、路径验证（path validation）与密钥提交加密（key-committing encryption）。文中给出了匿名性与可问责性的形式化分析，实现了协议原型并评估了性能。该协议适用于需要兼顾匿名表达与滥用追责的网络场景（如匿名举报、合规通信等），为匿名网络的实际部署提供了一种更现实的设计方案。适合网络协议研究者、隐私增强技术开发者以及关注匿名滥用治理的安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次以可落地的架构同时实现匿名与问责，减少每包公钥开销至每会话，为匿名网络反滥用和合规审计提供了新思路。

items.title: Defense-as-Skill: Evolving Runtime Guard Skill for Skill-Augmented Agents
items.summary: Skill-augmented agents load reusable skills as persistent runtime context, improving task performance but also giving malicious skills a durable channel for steering future actions. Such skills may leak secrets, corrupt code, bypass approvals, or stage data for exfiltration only after a concrete user task and workspace state make the unsafe action appear useful. This makes pre-install vetting insufficient and calls for runtime, task-conditioned protection. We propose Defense-as-Skill, a defense paradigm that implements the runtime guard itself as an installable, inspectable, and editable skill. Our guard, SkillSonar, runs alongside untrusted task skills and checks sensitive actions against the user's task boundary, routing each action to an allow, replan, or confirmation decision without modifying the underlying agent runtime. To study this setting, we construct SCOPE-R, a task-conditioned dataset covering 6 risk families and 21 sub-categories, with 206 attack-confirmed malicious instances and 43 benign tasks. We then improve SkillSonar on the SCOPE-R training subset using runtime guard-skill evolution, a Monte-Carlo Tree Search procedure that evolves the on-disk guard skill from feedback on the rollouts. Across Claude Code and OpenClaw, the evolved guard substantially reduces attack success while maintaining a favorable safety-utility trade-off. On repeated GLM-5 runs, SkillSonar reduces ID ASR from 0.482 to 0.104 and OOD ASR from 0.606 to 0.115. Further analyses demonstrate transfer across victim models, held-out risk families, and external benchmarks, as well as retained protection against adaptive attackers. Ablations further show that explicit safety responsibility assignment and the skill-native representation are both important to the observed gains.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文围绕技能增强型智能体（skill-augmented agents）的安全防护问题展开。这类智能体将可复用的技能作为持久化运行时上下文加载，虽然提升了任务性能，但也为恶意技能提供了持续影响后续行动的通道。恶意技能只有在具体用户任务和工作区状态出现时，才会触发泄露秘密、破坏代码、绕过审批或为数据外传做准备等不安全行为，这使得安装前的审查变得不足，需要依赖运行时且针对任务条件的保护机制。为此，作者提出了一种名为“Defense-as-Skill”的防御范式，其核心思想是将运行时防护本身实现为一种可安装、可检查和可编辑的技能。作者实现了具体的防护系统 SkillSonar，它运行在不可信的任务技能旁边，在用户任务边界内检查敏感操作，并将每个动作路由到允许（allow）、重新规划（replan）或确认（confirmation）三类决策，全程不修改底层智能体运行时。为了研究与评估这一设置，作者构建了 SCOPE-R 数据集，覆盖 6 个风险家族和 21 个子类别，包含 206 个经攻击确认的恶意实例和 43 个良性任务。随后，作者利用运行时防护技能演化（runtime guard-skill evolution）来改进 SkillSonar，该方法基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），从 rollout 反馈中演化磁盘上的防护技能。在 Claude Code 和 OpenClaw 两个平台上，演化后的防护显著降低了攻击成功率，同时保持了良好的安全-效用权衡。在重复的 GLM-5 运行中，SkillSonar 将同分布攻击成功率（ID ASR）从 0.482 降至 0.104，将分布外攻击成功率（OOD ASR）从 0.606 降至 0.115。进一步的实验表明，该防护能够跨受害者模型迁移、泛化到保留的风险家族和外部基准，并且对自适应攻击者仍能保持防护能力。消融研究还显示，明确的安全责任分配和技能原生表示都对所观察到的增益具有重要作用。该工作为技能增强型智能体的运行时安全提供了一种新颖且可行的解决路径。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对技能增强型LLM智能体的新型运行时防御范式，无需修改底层运行时，以可检查技能形式提供任务条件防护，为Agent安全提供了可落地的新思路，值得安全研究与工程人员关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于各类技能增强型智能体（如Claude Code、OpenClaw等），在恶意技能持久化场景下阻断越权或数据泄露行为，并可迁移到需要任务边界约束的LLM应用中。

items.title: One Prompt Is Enough: Watermark Laundering Through Foundation Image Models
items.summary: Invisible watermarks are typically evaluated against predefined perturbations such as compression, blur, noise, cropping, and denoising. Public foundation image models expose a distinct threat: an attacker can submit a watermarked image with a single reconstruction prompt and obtain a visually faithful output from which the invisible watermark can no longer be decoded reliably. We formalize this failure mode as watermark laundering and evaluate it using a joint payload-fidelity profile that combines bit error rate (BER) with visual and semantic preservation. Across six OpenAI and Google image editing models, three representative watermarking schemes, and 1,800 reconstructed outputs, we identify two complementary laundering regimes: OpenAI models produce the strongest payload disruption across the evaluated schemes, whereas Nano Banana 2 shows that DwtDct remains vulnerable under high-fidelity reconstruction. Prompt ablations show that no single removal-oriented instruction is necessary for payload disruption, indicating that the effect is primarily induced by the reconstruction pathway rather than by explicit attack wording. Comparisons with conventional attacks further show that prompt-conditioned reconstruction constitutes a distinct operational attack interface. These findings motivate foundation-model reconstruction as a missing robustness condition in invisible watermark evaluation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了一种针对不可见数字水印的新型攻击路径：基础图像模型重建（foundation image model reconstruction）导致的水印清洗（watermark laundering）。传统上，不可见水印的鲁棒性测试仅考虑压缩、模糊、噪声、裁剪、去噪等预定义扰动。然而，攻击者只需将含水印图像提交给公共基础图像模型，并附带单个重建提示（reconstruction prompt），即可获得视觉上忠实、但无法再可靠解码水印的输出图像。论文将这种失败模式正式化为水印清洗，并提出一种结合比特错误率（BER）与视觉/语义保持度的联合指标（payload-fidelity profile），以衡量清洗效果与图像质量之间的权衡。作者在六个 OpenAI 和 Google 的图像编辑模型上，对三种代表性水印方案进行了大规模实验，共生成 1,800 个重建输出。实验发现两种互补的清洗机制：OpenAI 模型在测试方案中普遍导致最强的水印载荷破坏，而 Nano Banana 2 模型则表明 DwtDct 水印在高保真重建下依然脆弱。Prompt 消融实验显示，无需任何显式的“去除水印”指令也能产生载荷破坏，说明该效果主要源于重建过程本身，而非提示词中的攻击性语义。与常规攻击（如压缩、滤波）的对比进一步证明，基于 prompt 的重建是一种独立且独特的攻击接口。该研究提示，基础模型重建应被纳入不可见水印的评估条件中，否则水印在现实场景中的保护能力可能被高估。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了公共基础图像模型可能被用于自动清除不可见水印，对依赖水印进行版权保护和内容溯源的安全方案构成潜在威胁。防御者需重新评估现有水印在真实 AI 生态下的鲁棒性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响范围包括使用不可见水印的图像版权保护、深度伪造溯源、内容审核等场景。所有声称具备鲁棒性的水印算法都可能受基础模型重建影响。
defense_advice_zh: 在内部水印鲁棒性测试中加入基础图像模型重建这一扰动条件
避免将不可见水印作为唯一溯源手段，可结合加密签名或链上存证
关注水印方案在生成式 AI 环境下的失效模式，提前设计升级策略
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: MutMem-V2: Cryptographically Authorized Mutation in Persistent Agent Memory Portable Verification and Reproducible Evidence
items.summary: MutMem V1 introduced retention-preserving, cryptographically authorized mutation for persistent agent memory but did not provide a complete portable verification contract or clean-install reproduction path. MutMem V2 closes that publication gap without introducing a second memory engine. It specifies exact canonical bytes, domain-separated object and bundle commitments, mandatory recall-evidence membership and ordering, external trust anchors, identity epochs, revocation, authorization, request receipts, ordered disclosure, and three mutation terminal types. The released protocol contains 18 versioned object schemas, 39 recall vectors, 15 mutation vectors, and 37 closed recall failure reasons. Independent Node and Python implementations agree on verdict and primary reason for all 72 structural and cryptographic terminals; a production-conformance corpus agrees on 42/42 cases across 28 required classes. A clean Node v26.8.1 installation reaches first-boot, restart, and scheduler readiness with no experimental memories. A separately scoped 120-unit Canary experiment supports only explicit-marker traversal. Every public table regenerates from a self-hashed aggregate, and an independent verifier reconstructs the statistics and claim boundaries. Historical V1 empirical results remain historical. MutMem V2 supports claims about portable integrity, authorization, traceability, conformance, and reproducibility under stated assumptions; it does not establish semantic truth, universal robustness, or independent replication.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文介绍 MutMem-V2，一个针对持久代理内存的密码学授权变异协议。V1 版本引入了保留记忆的、基于密码学授权的变异机制，但缺少完整的可移植验证契约和干净安装的复现路径。V2 版本在不引入第二套内存引擎的前提下，补齐了这一发布差距。该协议精确指定了规范字节序列、域分离对象与包级承诺、强制召回证据的成员性与顺序性、外部信任锚点、身份周期、撤销机制、授权流程、请求回执、有序披露，以及三种变异终端类型。协议包含 18 个版本化对象模式、39 个召回向量、15 个变异向量和 37 个封闭式召回失败原因。独立实现的 Node 和 Python 版本在所有 72 个结构与密码学终端上判定一致；生产一致性语料库在 28 个必需类别上的 42/42 个案例全部一致。在干净的 Node v26.8.1 环境下，安装后能够达到首次启动、重启和调度就绪，且不包含任何实验性记忆。一个单独的 120 单元 Canary 实验仅支持显式标记遍历。每个公开表格均由自哈希聚合重新生成，独立验证器可重建统计数据和声明边界。历史 V1 的实证结果保留为历史记录。MutMem V2 支持关于可移植完整性、授权、可追溯性、一致性和可复现性的主张（在既定假设下），但不建立语义真理性、通用鲁棒性或独立复制性。该工作适用于关注代理内存安全、协议可验证性和 AI 系统可审计性的人士。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 代理持久内存的完整性与授权是 LLM 智能体安全的基础。MutMem-V2 提供了一套可移植、可验证的协议契约，有助于检测内存篡改和审计代理行为，对构建可信 AI 系统具有架构参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响 AI 代理内存管理、可验证计算和 LLM 工具链的安全设计；其域分离承诺和独立验证思想也可迁移至智能体日志审计、供应链完整性验证等场景。
defense_advice_zh: 对于使用持久代理内存的系统，应确保对内存读写施加密码学授权并保留证据链，以便事后审计。
采用可移植的验证契约和独立实现交叉核对，减少因单一实现缺陷带来的信任风险。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Griotte: Verified Compartmentalisation via Capabilities
items.summary: CHERIoT is a novel hardware-software co-design that leverages hardware capabilities to define a notion of compartment, in a minimalistic capability-based OS, CHERIoT RTOS. By default, compartments are isolated to limit damage in case of bugs or malicious behaviour. To allow cross-compartment communication, the OS provides a privileged component, called the switcher. The switcher provides an interface for cross-compartment calls, while enforcing isolation between compartments and guaranteeing stack safety. Together with hardware capabilities, the switcher is critical to enforce the security guarantees of the CHERIoT compartment model. The design of CHERIoT raises two questions: First, how can one formalise the informal notion of compartmentalisation that CHERIoT compartments are designed to provide? And second, given that the safety properties of CHERIoT hinge on the complementary roles of the capability machine and of the switcher, does the design of CHERIoT enforce the desired security properties? In this paper, we introduce Griotte and Griotte OS, idealised but faithful versions of the CHERIoT machine and the CHERIoT RTOS, which we use to answer these two questions: First, we formally capture the aforementioned security guarantees in the form of a continuation-based logical relation which captures the combined behaviour of the switcher and of the capability machine. And second, we define a specification for the Griotte switcher that enforces those guarantees, and prove that the implementation meets the specification. We demonstrate Griotte on a range of key scenarios illustrating different aspects of CHERIoT, including integrity of the local state in the presence of memory sharing with unknown code. Our approach is modular: we verify compartments individually, and then compose their specifications. Together, our contributions give a solid formal foundation to the design of CHERIoT.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文介绍 Griotte 与 Griotte OS——CHERIoT 安全架构的理想化但忠实的形式化模型。CHERIoT 是一种硬件-软件协同设计，通过硬件 capabilities 定义隔离域（compartment），并在极简的 CHERIoT RTOS 中实现默认隔离，以限制程序缺陷或恶意行为造成的损害。为实现跨隔离域通信，系统引入特权组件 switcher，它提供跨域调用接口，同时强制隔离并保障栈安全。CHERIoT 的安全保证依赖于 capability 机器与 switcher 的互补机制，因此其设计面临两个根本问题：如何精确形式化非正式的隔离域概念，以及设计是否真正强制了所有期望的安全属性。为解决这些问题，作者构建了 CHERIoT 机器与 RTOS 的理想化模型，并利用基于 continuation 的逻辑关系形式化地刻画了 switcher 与 capability 机器的组合行为，从而捕获了隔离域安全的精确语义。在此基础上，论文为 Griotte switcher 定义了满足这些安全保证的形式化规范，并通过机器辅助证明验证了其实现确实符合规范。作者还通过多个关键场景展示了 Griotte 的效力，包括在与未知代码共享内存时如何维护本地状态完整性等典型问题。所采用的方法具有模块性：可以独立验证每个隔离域，然后将各规格组合以获得系统级保证。整体而言，该工作为 CHERIoT 的隔离模型提供了坚实的数学基础，有助于建立对 capability 架构安全属性的高置信度理解，也展示了利用逻辑关系验证系统级安全性质的可行路径。本文主要面向编程语言与系统安全形式化验证领域的研究人员，但对关注基于 capability 的隔离机制与安全关键系统可信性的蓝队工程师同样具有重要的参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对基于 capability 的 CHERIoT 架构，本文提供了严格的形式化安全证明，使防御者能清晰理解隔离域、switcher 与栈安全承诺。有助于安全工程师在部署依赖硬件隔离的系统时建立信任边界并识别隐含风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响 CHERIoT 及类似 capability 安全架构的设计与验证流程，为形式化审计和回归测试提供数学基础，可迁移至其他微内核或硬件辅助隔离系统。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: JENGA: Exploiting Counter-Based RowHammer Countermeasures to Break Real-Time Predictability
items.summary: Safety-critical real-time systems must satisfy multiple dependability requirements, notably time predictability and security. In such systems, tasks must complete within bounded and known execution times, typically characterised through Worst-Case Execution Time (WCET) analysis. At the same time, DRAM-based platforms are increasingly sensitive to the RowHammer read-disturbance security vulnerability, which has motivated the development of numerous hardware and software countermeasures in both academia and industry. However, the impact of these defences is generally evaluated in terms of average-case performance, a metric that is insufficient for safetycritical real-time systems, where worst-case behaviour is the primary concern. In this paper, we study the impact of RowHammer countermeasures based on hardware counters on the timing behaviour of real-time systems. We use a Per-Row-Activation-Counter (PRAC) countermeasure as a case study, standardised for recent DDR5 memories, and show that it can introduce significant timing variations. Based on this observation, we introduce JENGA, an attack in which an attacker-controlled task manipulates the internal state of the RowHammer countermeasure mechanism to increase the execution time of a victim real-time task beyond its expected WCET. We implement JENGA in a gem5 and Ramulator 2.0 simulation environment and evaluate its impact on TACLeBench workloads. We show that such an attack can delay tasks up to 200% of their WCET, making the initial timesafety assumptions unsafe. To address this issue, we derive a safe analytical bound that accounts for mitigation-induced delays in WCET analysis for DRAM systems protected by hardware countermeasures, such as PRAC-N.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 安全关键实时系统要求任务必须在有限且已知的最坏情况执行时间（WCET）内完成，以确保时间可预测性。然而，DRAM存储器受到RowHammer读干扰漏洞的影响，许多硬件/软件防御措施已被提出。现有文献通常以平均性能评估这些防御的开销，但对于实时系统而言，最坏情况行为才是核心关注点。本文研究基于硬件计数器的RowHammer防御（以DDR5标准中的Per-Row-Activation-Counter（PRAC）为例）对实时系统时序行为的影响，发现该类防御可以引入显著的时序变化。在此基础上，作者提出一种名为JENGA的攻击，攻击者通过控制一个任务来操纵RowHammer计数器的内部状态，从而将受害实时任务的执行时间推高至超出其预期WCET。攻击在gem5与Ramulator 2.0模拟环境中实现，并在TACLeBench工作负载上评估。实验结果表明，该攻击可将任务延迟到其WCET的200%，使原有的时间安全假设不再成立。为应对此问题，作者推导了一个安全的解析上界，用于在受PRAC-N等硬件计数器保护的DRAM系统上进行WCET分析，从而将缓解机制引起的延迟计入最坏情况预算。该工作揭示了RowHammer防御与实时系统时序保证之间的深层冲突，为设计安全的实时平台提供了新的分析基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次展示RowHammer的计数器型缓解措施本身可被武器化，通过操纵内存控制器状态破坏实时任务的时间保证，使WCET分析失效。对使用DDR5且依赖时间隔离的安全关键系统构成新威胁，需引起设计者重视。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响采用PRAC等计数器型RowHammer防护的实时DRAM系统，尤其对具有严格时序要求的嵌入式/汽车/工业控制场景构成潜在风险；相关的边界分析方法也可适用于其他基于计数器的抗扰机制。
defense_advice_zh: 在WCET分析中计入RowHammer缓解机制的最坏情况延迟
评估攻击者任务与受害任务在内存控制器层面的潜在干扰点
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Influence of Logging Frameworks on Bind9
items.summary: Host-based Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS) rely on application logs to detect and block malicious activity. However, on modern high-speed networks the logging subsystem itself becomes a bottleneck: an attacker can hide traces simply by generating enough traffic to overwhelm the application's log pipeline, dropping crucial traces. In this work, we show that widely deployed setups such as Fail2Ban monitoring BIND9 can be defeated with less than 65 Mbps of DNS traffic. Further, we show that when replacing core components of the IPS architecture with their higher-performance equivalent, iptables with eBPF and regex matching with Hyperscan, the logging backends themselves become the bottleneck. Therefore, we present FIPS, a new IPC designed for high-performance logging that bypasses the kernel and reduces copying of the log messages to a minimum. FIPS uses per-thread lock free shared memory ring buffers, supporting multiple independent consumers reading the same log stream at their own pace. FIPS offers both a native API and a drop-in replacement for the syslog interface. Our evaluation with BIND 9 shows that FIPS introduces almost no overhead compared to disabled logging, logs more requests than any other evaluated framework, and enables the IPS to ban malicious clients $2.5\times$ faster than with file logging while sustaining $2^{16}$ attacking clients at one million requests per second.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究日志框架对基于主机的入侵防御系统（IPS）的影响，发现现代高速网络下日志子系统本身会成为瓶颈，攻击者可通过产生大量流量淹没应用日志管道来隐藏痕迹。作者证明，在常见的 Fail2Ban 监控 BIND9 部署中，攻击者仅需不到 65 Mbps 的 DNS 流量即可击败该 IPS。当将 IPS 架构中的核心组件替换为更高效的等价物（如用 eBPF 替代 iptables、用 Hyperscan 替代正则匹配）后，日志后端本身成为新的瓶颈。为此，作者提出 FIPS（Fast Inter-Process Signaling/logging），一种专为高性能日志设计的新 IPC 机制，绕过内核并将日志消息的复制次数降至最低。FIPS 使用每线程无锁共享内存环形缓冲区，支持多个独立消费者按自身速度读取同一日志流。FIPS 提供原生 API 和 syslog 接口的即插即用替代。在 BIND9 上的评估显示，与禁用日志相比，FIPS 几乎不引入额外开销；相比其他日志框架，FIPS 能记录更多请求；与文件日志相比，FIPS 使 IPS 封禁恶意客户端的速度快 2.5 倍，并能以每秒一百万请求的速率维持处理 2^16 个攻击客户端。该研究揭示了日志基础设施在安全检测中的关键作用，并为高性能日志设计提供了新思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 帮助安全团队理解日志管道瓶颈如何被攻击者利用，以及如何通过高性能日志设计（如 FIPS）提升 IPS 效能。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响依赖 BIND9 和 Fail2Ban 等日志驱动 IPS 的部署场景；可迁移至其他高吞吐日志驱动的安全检测系统。

items.title: Pricing the DeFi Tail: Do Protocols or Depositors Price Operational Risk?
items.summary: Similar to banks, DeFi protocols expose depositors to operational risk (USD 9.45 billion across 1,075 events since 2020). Unlike banks, they are not required to hold capital against it. A protocol may maintain a buffer voluntarily. Absent one, the risk falls on the depositor, who should then demand a risk premium in the supply yield. I quantify the underlying tail on one benchmark, a per-sector Basel loss-distribution approach fitted to a new operational risk event dataset, and test both margins against it. Tails in the four core sectors are no heavier than the Moscadelli banking band $[0.85, 1.39]$. Bridge, Derivatives, and the residual Other sector exhibit cyber-loss-level tails ($\hatξ\approx 1.6$), with point estimates past the infinite-mean boundary. The Lending tail implies a $\mathrm{VaR}_{99.9}$ capital buffer of 18% of TVL and of the ten largest Lending venues, the four holding a buffer cover on average 5% of it. Under market discipline, depositors should demand a higher yield in compensation where a venue does not maintain a buffer. I find that venues without a buffer pay a higher premium than those with (a 125-bps gap in medians): evidence the market discriminates in the right direction. However, the premium falls far short of an adequately priced tail. This unpriced tail falls disproportionately on the retail depositor, who sees only the posted rate but lacks the information and skills to price it. Because these products are not bank-regulated, I recommend disclosure over capital mandates: protocols, and any service providers that front access to it, should publish standardized losses, existing capital buffers and tail coverage.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究去中心化金融（DeFi）协议中的操作风险定价问题。自2020年以来，DeFi协议因操作风险事件损失了94.5亿美元，涉及1075起事件，但与传统银行不同，DeFi协议无需为此持有监管资本。协议可能自愿维持资本缓冲，若没有缓冲，风险则由存款人承担，因此存款人理应在存款收益中要求风险溢价。作者采用巴塞尔损失分布法（LDA）拟合新的操作风险事件数据集，量化四个核心行业（借贷、去中心化交易所、衍生品、桥接等）的尾部风险，并检验协议缓冲与市场纪律是否合理定价。研究发现：四个核心行业的尾部参数不超过Moscadelli银行业区间[0.85, 1.39]；但桥接、衍生品和残余其他行业的尾部呈现网络攻击级别的厚尾（ξ^≈1.6），点估计甚至超过无限均值边界。借贷行业的尾部风险意味着VaR_99.9对应的资本缓冲相当于总锁仓价值（TVL）的18%；在十大借贷平台中，只有四家持有缓冲，平均覆盖率仅为5%。在市场纪律方面，无缓冲的平台确实比有缓冲的平台支付更高的收益率（中位数差125个基点），表明市场在向正确方向区分；但溢价远不足以覆盖尾部风险。这种未定价风险主要落在零售存款人身上，他们只看到公布的利率，缺乏信息与技能去定价。由于这些产品不受银行监管，作者建议采用披露而非资本强制要求：协议及其前端服务商应发布标准化的损失数据、现有资本缓冲和尾部覆盖率。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文揭示了DeFi协议操作风险（含智能合约漏洞、桥接攻击等）在市场上未被充分定价，影响存款人安全。安全团队可借此理解安全事件（如黑客攻击）的经济后果，以及资本缓冲对风险吸收的作用。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对DeFi安全审计、风险管理和保险定价具有参考价值，尤其强调桥接和衍生品领域的厚尾风险，指导安全投入与应急准备金评估。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Effective Interventions Against AI-Enhanced Scams
items.summary: In 2025, scams were responsible for an estimated $442 billion in direct losses globally. In the United States, reported losses increased by nearly 400% between 2020 and 2025. Though AI in scamming is a relatively new phenomenon, its use significantly changes the economics of scams as well as the bottlenecks in scam operations. In this paper I investigate what interventions will remain effective under this new AI-driven scamming regime. I develop a simple model of scam profits to understand how different interventions asymptotically affect scam operations. I find that three levers--reporting rate, centralization of reporting, and report accuracy--multiply in their effect on expected victims per scam channel, reducing revenue per scam channel while increasing costs. Because effects multiply, interventions affecting all three could have a significant effect on the profitability of the scam business model. My analysis suggests that even modest reporting rates against high-value scam infrastructure could have significant impacts on scam profitability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文针对2025年全球诈骗直接损失估计达4420亿美元、美国报告损失在2020至2025年间增长近400%的严峻背景，系统研究AI增强诈骗（AI-enhanced scams）这一新兴现象对传统干预措施有效性的冲击。作者指出，AI技术显著改变了诈骗的经济学模型和运营瓶颈，使得原有防御策略可能失效。为此，论文构建了一个简洁的诈骗利润模型，用于分析不同干预措施在渐进意义上如何影响诈骗行为。核心发现是三个关键干预杠杆——举报率（reporting rate）、举报集中度（centralization of reporting）和举报准确性（report accuracy）——对每个诈骗渠道的预期受害者数量产生乘数效应：它们既能减少每个渠道的收入，又能增加其运营成本。由于这些效应相互叠加，如果同时作用于这三个方面，可能对诈骗商业模式的整体盈利能力造成重大打击。分析还表明，即便是针对高价值诈骗基础设施的适度举报率，也可能对诈骗利润产生显著影响。论文通过经济学建模揭示了传统举报机制在AI时代的新价值，为政策制定者、平台运营者和安全社区提供了理论依据与干预优先级建议。适合关注反欺诈策略、AI滥用治理及安全经济学的研究人员、风险控制从业者和公共政策制定者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: AI大幅降低了诈骗的规模化门槛，传统举报与封禁手段可能失效。该研究证明举报率、集中度和准确性三者相乘地打击诈骗盈利，为防御者设计有限资源下的干预策略提供了量化方向。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响反诈骗平台、支付机构、社交网络等依赖举报机制的安全防线；其数学模型可迁移到打击钓鱼、虚假账号等AI放大场景。
defense_advice_zh: 提升用户举报的便利性与上报率，特别是针对高价值诈骗基础设施。
推动跨平台举报信息集中整合和共享，降低分散化带来的盲区。
引入精准的举报验证机制，提高举报准确性以减少误报干扰。
结合经济模型评估干预措施的联合效应，优先投入三重杠杆的协同建设。

items.title: Differentially Private Paired Table-Image Multimodal Synthesis
items.summary: Differentially private (DP) synthesis has been extensively studied for tabular and image data separately, yet many real-world datasets contain images paired with multivariate tabular records. Synthesizing such data is particularly challenging under DP, as the two modalities favor different private learning mechanisms while their dependence must also be preserved. To address this challenge, we propose DP-TabImage, a modality-specialized framework for private paired synthesis. DP-TabImage instantiates the factorization $p(x,y)=p_T(y)p_I(x\;|\;y)$ using a private Probabilistic Graphical Model for the multivariate table distribution and a table-conditioned diffusion model trained with DP-SGD for the conditional image distribution. To facilitate conditional learning under clipped and noisy gradients, we further pretrain the model on private table-image prototypes, pairing privately constructed attribute-conditioned images with tabular vectors derived from the already private tabular model at no additional privacy cost. Experiments on three real-world datasets show that DP-TabImage achieves a strong balance among tabular fidelity, image fidelity, and cross-modal alignment. Our analysis further reveals that visual warm-up primarily improves marginal image fidelity, whereas aligned table-image warm-up is critical for improving cross-modal correspondence. Our source code is available in the GitHub repository, https://github.com/KaiChen9909/TabImage_Syn.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向配对表格-图像数据的差分隐私（DP）合成方法。现实场景中，许多数据集由图像及其对应的多变量表格记录组成（如医学影像与患者指标），但在差分隐私约束下合成这类数据颇具挑战，因为图像和表格通常需要不同的私有学习机制，同时还需保持两者的依赖关系。作者提出DP-TabImage框架，采用模态专门化设计，基于概率分解p(x,y)=p_T(y)p_I(x|y)：用私有概率图模型（PGM）对多变量表格分布p_T(y)建模，用经DP-SGD训练的表条件扩散模型对条件图像分布p_I(x|y)建模。为应对梯度裁剪与噪声对条件学习的干扰，他们先在私有表格-图像原型上进行预训练，即使用私有构造的属性条件图像与从已私有表格模型中导出的表格向量配对，且不增加额外隐私成本。在三个真实数据集上的实验表明，DP-TabImage在表格保真度、图像保真度和跨模态对齐三者间取得了良好平衡；分析进一步发现，视觉预热主要提升边缘图像保真度，而对齐的表格-图像预热对改善跨模态语义对应至关重要。该方法为隐私保护下的多模态数据发布和下游任务提供了可行途径，可作为数据持有者在合规前提下共享敏感表格与图像数据的技术参考。适合研究差分隐私、合成数据、生成模型以及隐私敏感领域（如医疗、金融）数据共享的研究者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 安全从业者在处理敏感多模态数据（如医疗记录+影像）时，需兼顾隐私与可用性。本文提供了一种在差分隐私保证下合成配对表格-图像数据的方法，有助于构建符合隐私法规的数据共享与测试流程。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于医疗影像+电子病历、金融交易图像+表格等场景，在保护个体隐私的前提下生成高保真合成数据，用于模型训练、系统测试和数据分析，减少隐私泄露风险。

items.title: A Version Space Approach for Digital Circuit Analysis
items.summary: Many questions about a digital circuit take the same form. A hidden object is consistent with a set of observations, and one wants to know how many remain consistent and which observation to make next. The set of surviving candidates is the version space, and its size, on a logarithmic scale, measures how much the observations have settled. This paper develops the version-space view as one method and applies it to two circuit-analysis problems usually treated as unrelated. The first is probabilistic combinational equivalence checking, where the candidates are Boolean functions and the observations are modified-Haar spectral coefficients. A method proposed in 2002 posed this counting problem and solved only two special cases, leaving the general case an enumeration exponential in the number of observations. We close it. A reparameterization onto block sums turns the dependence among nested coefficients into locality, a sum--product recursion counts the surviving functions exactly in time polynomial in the truth-table size, closed forms follow for a single coefficient, a coefficient pair, and every ancestor-closed set, and the error of the independence approximation the 2002 work resorted to equals a computable lattice index. Every formula is checked against exhaustive enumeration and reproduces the 2002 tables. The second application is key counting for logic-locked netlists, where the candidates are keys and the observations are oracle responses. The same recursion, run over the gate-level factor graph, computes the number of keys still consistent with a set of queries; across seventy instances of the TrustHub obfuscation release the surviving entropy falls below the advertised key length every time. The two applications are one method: a witness supplies observations, each removes candidates, and the version space is counted exactly.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
这篇论文提出了一种基于版本空间（Version Space）的数字电路分析统一框架。版本空间是指与一组观测一致的所有候选对象的集合，其大小（对数尺度）可以度量观测对候选对象的确定程度。作者将电路中的许多问题表述为：给定一个隐藏对象与一组观测一致，希望知道还有多少候选对象保持一致，以及应该进行下一个什么观测。该论文将版本空间方法应用于两个通常被视为无关的问题。

第一个应用是概率组合等价性检查。候选对象是布尔函数，观测是修改后的Haar谱系数。此前2002年的方法只解决两个特例，一般情况需要枚举，复杂度随观测数量指数增长。本文通过将问题重参数化为块和，将嵌套系数之间的依赖转化为局部性，利用求和-乘积递归在真值表大小的多项式时间内精确计算幸存函数数量。还对单个系数、系数对以及每个祖先封闭集合推导了闭式解，并证明了独立近似的误差等于一个可计算的格指标。所有公式通过与穷举枚举比较，复现了2002年的表格。

第二个应用是逻辑锁定网表中的密钥计数。候选对象是密钥，观测是oracle（黑盒）响应。同样的递归在图级别因子图上运行，计算与一组查询仍一致的密钥数量。在TrustHub混淆基准的70个实例上，幸存熵每次都低于声称的密钥长度。

作者强调这两个应用实际上是同一种方法：观察者提供观测，每个观测移除部分候选，版本空间被精确计数。该方法有助于评估逻辑锁定方案的安全性，并为电路验证提供新的理论工具。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该文为逻辑锁定的安全性分析提供了精确的密钥计数方法，能帮助硬件安全工程师评估电路混淆强度的真实下界，避免高估防护能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可用于硬件安全验证（逻辑混淆强度评估）、组合等价性检查和相关EDA工具；对硬件供应链的可信性分析有潜在价值。
defense_advice_zh: 在采用逻辑锁定方案时，应利用版本空间计数评估实际密钥熵，确保混淆强度与声称一致。
对第三方提供的混淆电路，可应用该方法验证其抗暴力枚举或SAT攻击的鲁棒性。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Capability-Gated Language Models: Security Composes, Utility Does Not
items.summary: Deployed language model safeguards (safety fine-tuning, filtering, unlearning) vary by principal only outside the model weights: filters are reconfigured, tiers are multiplied, and artefacts are reissued; inside one set of weights every request meets the same model configuration. This motivates us to define capability-gated deployment: per-principal access control inside one set of weights, whose configurations form a lattice - meets accumulate a principal's restrictions and joins pool a coalition's reach. We instantiate it by sparse rank gating over an existing nested-factorisation mechanism, guide profile search with one-pass attribution, and read every result once from a pre-registered held-out split. Security composes: provably at meets under a monotone-elicitation assumption we falsify pointwise. In two lineages the median held-out meet deepens suppression; the one effect surviving correction strengthens it. Utility does not: individually harmless profiles can compose to retention and fluency damage, and no compositional bound exists.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出一种名为“能力门控部署”(capability-gated deployment) 的范式，旨在解决传统大语言模型安全机制在细粒度访问控制上的不足。传统防护手段如安全微调、过滤、遗忘等，通常只在模型权重之外进行差异化配置（如重新配置过滤器、增加层级或重新签发工件），而在一组固定权重内，所有请求都面对相同的模型行为。作者主张将“按主体（principal）的访问控制”内化到同一组权重中：不同主体拥有不同的能力配置，这些配置构成一个格（lattice），其中“meet”操作累积限制条件，“join”操作合并联盟可达范围。实现上，论文利用已有的嵌套因子分解机制，引入稀疏秩门控（sparse rank gating）来实例化不同能力配置；使用单次归因（one-pass attribution）引导配置文件搜索，并从一个预先注册的留出测试集读取结果，以避免实验偏差。论文的核心发现是：安全性具有可组合性——在单调启发假设下，meet操作能够可证明地增强抑制效果；实验在两个模型谱系中观察到中位留出集上的抑制加深，且通过多重比较校正后效果仍显著。然而，效用不具备可组合性：单独无害的配置组合后可能导致保留能力和流畅度严重下降，并且不存在通用的组合界限。该工作为多租户环境下的模型安全配置提供了形式化基础，但尚处于早期研究阶段。适合关注LLM安全机制、访问控制、以及模型治理的研究人员和平台安全架构师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 这项研究提出在单一模型权重内部实现按主体的安全能力控制，挑战了传统“外部过滤+整体微调”的范式，对多租户AI服务、模型共享场景的防御设计具有启发意义。安全组合性证明有助于构建可验证的细粒度防护，但效用退化问题警示实际部署需谨慎。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 若后续成熟，可应用于SaaS大模型平台的多租户隔离、不同安全等级内容的动态管控、以及模型遗忘的精细调节。当前仍以研究为主，尚无直接威胁影响。

items.title: NeuroPriv: Adversarial Representation Learning for Privacy in Wearable EEG Systems
items.summary: Wearable EEG systems may expose sensitive information beyond their intended health function, creating substantial risks to neuroprivacy. In this work, we show that commonly used EEG features can reveal participant identity and demographic attributes in addition to supporting the intended cognitive task. Wearable EEG is increasingly being explored for cognitive monitoring, neurological assessment, and longitudinal digital-health applications, yet many systems assume that transmitting compact spectral or spatial features instead of raw EEG provides sufficient privacy protection. Using EEGMAT as a motivating case study, we find that compact EEG features achieve a balanced accuracy of 0.788 for cognitive-state classification while enabling gender, age, and subject-identity inference with balanced accuracies of 0.858, 0.789, and 0.692, respectively. We further show that privacy-aware representation learning preserves task performance at 0.781 while reducing these inference accuracies to 0.563, 0.467, and 0.206. These findings motivate purpose-limited representations and explicit privacy auditing in wearable neurohealth systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: NeuroPriv 是一篇针对可穿戴脑电图（EEG）系统的隐私风险研究。论文指出，可穿戴 EEG 设备在用于认知监测、神经评估和纵向数字健康应用时，往往只传输压缩后的频谱或空间特征而非原始脑电信号，并假设这种做法足以保护隐私。基于 EEGMAT 这一案例，作者验证了该假设不成立：紧凑的 EEG 特征在实现认知状态分类（平衡准确率 0.788）的同时，可以被恶意方或不当分析用于推断用户的性别（0.858）、年龄（0.789）和个人身份（0.692），从而造成神经隐私泄露。为缓解此类风险，论文提出 NeuroPriv，一种基于对抗表示学习的隐私感知表征方法。该方法在训练中引入对抗目标，削弱特征中与敏感属性相关的编码信息，同时保持对主要认知任务的有用性。实验结果显示，NeuroPriv 将认知状态分类的平衡准确率轻微调整至 0.781，同时将性别、年龄和身份推断的准确率显著压低至 0.563、0.467 和 0.206，表明通过显式隐私审计和目的受限表示，可以在任务性能与隐私保护之间取得有效的平衡。该研究呼吁可穿戴神经健康系统在架构设计中嵌入隐私保护机制，而非依赖朴素的数据压缩作为安全边界。论文适合从事 EEG 信号处理、隐私增强机器学习、医疗可穿戴设备的隐私工程师、算法研究员以及神经技术伦理与合规人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究实证揭示了可穿戴EEG中常见的紧凑特征并不能防止身份和敏感人口统计学信息泄露，为神经隐私保护提供了可量化的攻击面证据，并展示了对策的有效性。安全从业者在设计医疗/健康物联网系统时需重视深度特征推理风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用EEG特征进行认知监测或神经评估的可穿戴设备厂商、数字健康平台以及相关AI模型设计者；其对抗表征学习思路也可迁移至其他生物信号（如心率、皮肤电）的隐私保护场景。
detection_signals_zh: EEG特征中可用于推断性别/年龄/身份的统计模式

defense_advice_zh: 对EEG特征进行显式隐私审计，测量性别/年龄/身份推断准确率
采用对抗表示学习等目的受限表征技术，削弱敏感属性编码
尽量传输仅与具体任务相关的嵌入，避免不必要的高信息量特征

items.title: DUPIN: Attack Learning Is Still Needed! Demonstrating Few-Shot after Unsupervised Pretraining Is A Nimble Forensics Learner
items.summary: We propose a novel approach to learning-based attack forensics called DUPIN. DUPIN performs unsupervised pre-training on an enormous amount of audit events in the form of provenance graphs. It then proceeds to a few-shot learning stage, leveraging a small number of labeled attack examples to fine-tune its detection capabilities. We pretrain DUPIN on up to 38 - 52 days of audit logs (7.3TB total) and evaluate it against various baselines on 25 APT campaigns across four different data sources, facilitating the scalable evaluation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种名为 DUPIN 的新型学习型攻击取证方法。其核心思路是：先在海量的审计事件（以溯源图形式表示）上进行无监督预训练，使模型学习正常系统行为和通用结构模式；随后进入小样本学习阶段，仅利用少量带标注的攻击样例即可完成微调，从而获得针对特定攻击活动的检测能力。作者在最多 38-52 天的审计日志（总计 7.3TB）上预训练 DUPIN，并在来自四个不同数据源的 25 个 APT（高级持续性威胁）活动中与多种基线方法进行对比评估。实验表明，DUPIN 在仅需少量标注样本的情况下，能够有效提升攻击检测能力，实现了可扩展的评估流程。该方法的主要贡献在于：将无监督预训练与小样本学习结合，缓解了传统监督学习方法对大量人工标注攻击样本的依赖，同时利用溯源图结构捕捉系统级因果关系，提高了对复杂攻击链的取证分析能力。本文适合从事入侵检测、攻击取证、溯源分析和机器学习安全应用的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: DUPIN 展示了结合无监督预训练与小样本学习可大幅降低攻击检测对标注样本的依赖，为蓝队在海量日志中快速识别未知 APT 提供了新思路，值得关注其在真实溯源数据上的泛化能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该方法可能应用于企业级 EDR、溯源分析平台和 SOC 的日志审计流程，尤其适合在标注数据稀缺但审计日志充足的场景下辅助发现未知攻击模式。
